verses.28:16: Therefore, this is what the Lord GOD says: "Look, I have laid a stone in Zion, a proven stone, a precious cornerstone, a firmly laid foundation: the one who trusts will not act in haste.
verses.28:17: And I will make justice the measuring line and righteousness the plumb line; hail will sweep away the refuge of falsehood, and waters will overflow the hiding place.
verses.28:18: Then your covenant with death will be annulled, and your agreement with Sheol will not stand; when the sweeping scourge passes through, you will be trampled down by it.
verses.28:19: As often as it passes through, it will seize you; for morning after morning it will pass through, by day and by night, and it will be nothing but terror to understand the message.
verses.28:20: For the bed is too short to stretch out on, and the covering is too narrow when one wraps up in it."
verses.28:21: For the LORD will rise up as on Mount Perazim; He will rage as in the valley at Gibeon, to do His deed—strange is His deed—and to perform His work—alien is His work.
verses.28:22: And now, do not scoff, or your bonds will grow stronger; for I have heard of a complete and decreed destruction from the Lord GOD of hosts upon the whole earth.
verses.28:23: Give ear and hear my voice; pay attention and hear my speech.
verses.28:24: Does the plowman plow all day long to sow, opening and harrowing his ground?
verses.28:25: When he has leveled its surface, does he not scatter black cumin and broadcast cumin, and plant wheat in rows, barley in its marked-off place, and spelt along its border?
verses.28:26: For He instructs him in the proper way; his God teaches him.
verses.28:27: For black cumin is not threshed with a threshing sledge, nor is a cartwheel rolled over cumin; rather, black cumin is beaten out with a stick, and cumin with a rod.
verses.28:28: Is bread grain crushed? Indeed, he does not keep threshing it forever; when he drives the wheel of his cart and his horses, he does not crush it.
verses.28:29: This also comes from the LORD of hosts; He makes counsel wonderful and makes sound wisdom great.
verses.29:1: Woe to Ariel, Ariel, the city where David encamped! Add year to year; let the festivals complete their cycle.
verses.29:2: Yet I will bring distress to Ariel, and there will be moaning and mourning, and she will be to Me like Ariel.
verses.29:3: And I will encamp in a circle against you, and I will besiege you with a garrison, and I will raise up siegeworks against you.
verses.29:4: Then you will be brought low; from the ground you will speak, and from the dust your utterance will sink low. Your voice will be like a ghost from the ground, and from the dust your utterance will whisper.
verses.29:5: Yet the throng of your foreign foes will become like fine dust, and the throng of the ruthless like passing chaff; and it will happen in an instant, suddenly.
verses.29:6: By the LORD of hosts she will be visited, with thunder and earthquake and great noise, whirlwind and tempest, and flame of devouring fire.
verses.29:7: And the throng of all the nations that wage war against Ariel—all who wage war against her and her stronghold, and those who distress her—will be like a dream, a vision of the night.
verses.29:8: And it will be just as when a hungry man dreams, and look, he is eating, but he wakes up and his soul is empty; and as when a thirsty man dreams, and look, he is drinking, but he wakes up, and look, he is faint and his soul is craving—so will be the throng of all the nations that wage war against Mount Zion.
verses.29:9: Delay and be astounded; blind yourselves and be blind! They are drunk, but not with wine; they stagger, but not with strong drink.
verses.29:10: For the LORD has poured out upon you a spirit of deep sleep; He has tightly closed your eyes—the prophets—and covered your heads—the seers.
verses.29:11: And the vision of all this has become to you like the words of a sealed scroll, which they give to one who knows how to read, saying, "Please read this," and he says, "I cannot, for it is sealed."
verses.29:12: Then the scroll is given to one who does not know how to read, saying, "Please read this," and he says, "I do not know how to read."
verses.29:13: And the Lord said, "Because this people draws near—with their mouth and with their lips they honor Me—yet they have kept their heart far from Me, and their fear of Me has become a taught commandment of men,
verses.29:14: therefore, look, I will once more deal wondrously with this people, wondrously and with wonder; and the wisdom of their wise men will perish, and the discernment of their discerning men will conceal itself."
verses.29:15: Woe to those who go deep to hide a plan from the LORD, and their deeds are in a dark place, and they say, "Who sees us, and who knows us?"
verses.29:16: What perversity of yours! Shall the potter be reckoned like clay, so that what is made would say of its maker, "He did not make me," or what is formed say of the one who formed it, "He does not understand"?
verses.29:17: Is it not yet a very little while before Lebanon will turn into an orchard, and the orchard will be reckoned as a forest?
verses.29:18: On that day the deaf will hear the words of a scroll, and out of gloom and darkness the eyes of the blind will see.
verses.29:19: The humble will increase joy in the LORD, and the needy among mankind will exult in the Holy One of Israel.
verses.29:20: For the ruthless one will be no more, and the scoffer will come to an end, and all who keep watch for iniquity will be cut off—
verses.29:21: those who make a person guilty by a word, and lay a snare for the one who reproves at the gate, and turn aside the righteous with emptiness.
verses.29:22: Therefore, this is what the LORD, who redeemed Abraham, says to the house of Jacob: "Jacob will not now be ashamed, nor will his face now grow pale.
verses.29:23: For when he sees his children, the work of My hands, in his midst, they will sanctify My name; they will sanctify the Holy One of Jacob and stand in awe of the God of Israel.
verses.29:24: And those who stray in spirit will know understanding, and those who grumble will learn instruction."
verses.30:1: "Woe to rebellious sons," declares the LORD, "who form a plan, yet not from Me, and seal an alliance, yet not by My Spirit, in order to add sin upon sin;
verses.30:2: who set out to go down to Egypt without inquiring of My mouth, to seek shelter in Pharaoh's stronghold and to take refuge in the shadow of Egypt.
verses.30:3: So Pharaoh's stronghold will become shame for you, and the refuge in Egypt's shadow, disgrace.
verses.30:4: For his officials are at Zoan, and his messengers reach Hanes.
verses.30:5: Everyone comes to shame because of a people who cannot profit them, bringing neither help nor profit, but shame and also reproach."
verses.30:6: A pronouncement concerning the beasts of the Negev: Through a land of distress and anguish, from which come the lioness and the lion, the viper and the flying fiery serpent, they carry their wealth on the shoulders of young donkeys and their treasures on the humps of camels to a people who cannot profit them.
verses.30:7: Indeed, Egypt helps in futility and emptiness; therefore I have called this one, "Rahab: they sit idle."
verses.30:8: Now go, write it on a tablet before them and inscribe it on a scroll, so that it may remain for a future day, forever and ever.
verses.30:9: For this is a rebellious people, deceitful sons, sons unwilling to listen to the instruction of the LORD,
verses.30:10: who say to the seers, "Do not see," and to the visionaries, "Do not envision right things for us; speak smooth things to us, envision illusions;
verses.30:11: turn aside from the way, veer off from the path; remove the Holy One of Israel from before us."
verses.30:12: Therefore, this is what the Holy One of Israel says: "Because you have rejected this word and trusted in oppression and crookedness and leaned upon it,
verses.30:13: therefore this iniquity will be to you like a breach ready to fall, bulging out in a lofty wall, whose collapse comes suddenly, in an instant,
verses.30:14: and it will be shattered like the shattering of a potter's jar, crushed without sparing, so that among its crushed pieces no shard will be found to scoop fire from a hearth or to dip water from a cistern."
verses.30:15: For this is what the Lord GOD, the Holy One of Israel, says: "By returning and rest you will be saved; in calm and in confidence your strength will be." Yet you were unwilling,
verses.30:16: and you said, "No, rather on horses we will flee"—therefore you will flee!—"and on swift steeds we will ride"—therefore those who pursue you will be swift!
verses.30:17: One thousand will flee at the threat of one; at the threat of five you will flee, until you are left like a flagpole on the summit of a mountain and like a banner on a hill.
verses.30:18: Therefore the LORD waits to show you grace, and therefore He rises on high to have compassion on you. For the LORD is a God of justice; blessed are all who wait for Him.
verses.30:19: For a people will dwell in Zion, in Jerusalem; you will surely weep no more. He will certainly show you grace at the sound of your outcry; the moment He hears it, He will answer you.
verses.30:20: And though the Lord gives you bread of distress and water of oppression, your Teacher will no longer hide Himself, and your eyes will continually see your Teacher.
verses.30:21: And your ears will hear a word behind you, saying, "This is the way; walk in it," whenever you turn to the right or turn to the left.
verses.30:22: And you will defile the plating of your silver carved images and the sheathing of your gold cast image. You will scatter them like a menstrual cloth; "Get out!" you will say to it.
verses.30:23: Then He will give rain for your seed with which you sow the ground, and bread from the produce of the ground, and it will be rich and plentiful. In that day your livestock will graze in a broad pasture.
verses.30:24: And the oxen and the young donkeys that work the ground will eat seasoned fodder that has been winnowed with shovel and winnowing fork.
verses.30:25: And on every high mountain and on every elevated hill there will be streams and channels of water, on the day of great slaughter, when towers fall.
verses.30:26: And the light of the moon will be like the light of the sun, and the light of the sun will be sevenfold, like the light of seven days, on the day the LORD binds up the fracture of His people and heals the bruise of their wound.
verses.30:27: Look, the name of the LORD comes from afar, His anger burning, with heavy rising smoke; His lips are filled with indignation, and His tongue is like a devouring fire.
verses.30:28: And His breath is like a surging torrent reaching up to the neck, to sift nations in a sieve of ruin, with a bridle that leads astray upon the jaws of the peoples.
verses.30:29: You will have a song as on the night a festival is consecrated, and gladness of heart like one who walks with a flute to come to the mountain of the LORD, to the Rock of Israel.
verses.30:30: And the LORD will make the majesty of His voice heard and will show the descent of His arm in furious anger and a flame of devouring fire, with cloudburst, downpour, and hailstones.
verses.30:31: For at the voice of the LORD Assyria will be terror-stricken; with the rod He will strike.
verses.30:32: And every stroke of the appointed staff that the LORD brings down upon him will be with tambourines and lyres; and in battles of brandishing He will fight against them.
verses.30:33: For Topheth has been set in order from long ago; indeed, it has been prepared for the king. He has made it deep and wide; its pyre has fire and wood in abundance. The breath of the LORD, like a torrent of sulfur, sets it ablaze.
verses.31:1: Woe to those who go down to Egypt for help and lean upon horses, trusting in chariots because they are numerous and in horsemen because they are exceedingly mighty, while they do not look to the Holy One of Israel and do not seek the LORD.
verses.31:2: Yet He too is wise and brings disaster, and He does not retract His words; He will rise up against the house of evildoers and against the help of those who practice iniquity.
verses.31:3: And the Egyptians are human and not God, and their horses are flesh and not spirit. When the LORD stretches out His hand, the one who helps will stumble and the one who is helped will fall, and all of them together will perish.
verses.31:4: For this is what the LORD has said to me: "Just as the lion, even the young lion, growls over its prey when a full band of shepherds is summoned against it—it is not dismayed at their voice nor humbled by their uproar—so the LORD of hosts will come down to wage war upon Mount Zion and upon its hill.
verses.31:5: Like hovering birds, so the LORD of hosts will shield Jerusalem; shielding it, He will also deliver it; passing over it, He will also rescue it."
verses.31:6: Return to Him from whom the sons of Israel have deeply revolted.
verses.31:7: For in that day each one will reject his idols of silver and his idols of gold, which your own hands have made for you as a sin.
verses.31:8: And Assyria will fall by a sword not of a man, and a sword not of a mortal will devour him; he will flee from the sword, and his young men will become forced laborers.
verses.31:9: And his rock will pass away in terror, and his officials will be terrified at the standard, declares the LORD, whose fire is in Zion and whose furnace is in Jerusalem.
verses.32:1: See, a king will reign according to righteousness, and officials will rule according to justice.
verses.32:2: And a man will be like a refuge from the wind and a shelter from a downpour, like channels of water in a dry place, like the shade of a massive crag in a weary land.
verses.32:3: Then the eyes of those who see will not be shut, and the ears of those who hear will pay close attention.
verses.32:4: And the heart of the hasty will understand knowledge, and the tongue of stammerers will hasten to speak plainly.
verses.32:5: No longer will a fool be called noble, nor a scoundrel be spoken of as honorable.
verses.32:6: For a fool speaks folly, and his heart works iniquity, to practice godlessness and to speak error against the LORD, to leave the appetite of the hungry empty and to withhold drink from the thirsty.
verses.32:7: As for a scoundrel, his devices are evil; he devises wicked plots to ruin the poor with words of falsehood, even when the needy speaks what is just.
verses.32:8: But a noble man devises noble things, and upon noble things he stands.
verses.32:9: Women at ease, rise up, listen to my voice; self-assured daughters, give ear to my speech!
verses.32:10: In a year and some days you will tremble, you self-assured ones; for the vintage is finished, and the harvest gathering will not arrive.
verses.32:11: Shudder, you women at ease; tremble, you self-assured ones! Strip off and bare yourselves, and wrap your waists!
verses.32:12: They beat their breasts in mourning for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vine.
verses.32:13: Upon the soil of my people thorns and briers will grow up, yes, upon all the houses of joy in the jubilant city.
verses.32:14: For the palace has been abandoned, the throng of the city has been deserted; the citadel and watchtower have become caves forever, a joy for wild donkeys, a pasture for flocks,
verses.32:15: until a spirit is poured out on us from on high, and the wilderness turns into an orchard, and the orchard is reckoned as a forest.
verses.32:16: Then justice will dwell in the wilderness, and righteousness will abide in the orchard.
verses.32:17: And the work of righteousness will be peace, and the labor of righteousness will be calm and security forever.
verses.32:18: And my people will dwell in a home of peace, and in dwellings of security, and in tranquil resting places.
verses.32:19: Yet it will hail when the forest comes down, and in lowliness the city will be brought low.
verses.32:20: Blessed are you who sow by all waters, who send out the foot of the ox and the donkey.
verses.33:1: Woe, ravager, though you have not been ravaged, and treacherous one, though they have not acted treacherously against him! When you finish ravaging, you will be ravaged; when you cease acting treacherously, they will act treacherously against you.
verses.33:2: LORD, show grace to us; for You we have waited. Be their arm every morning, indeed our salvation in a time of distress.
verses.33:3: At the sound of uproar, peoples flee; at Your exaltation, nations scatter.
verses.33:4: And your spoil will be gathered like the gathering of the caterpillar; like the rushing of locusts, one rushes upon it.
verses.33:5: Exalted is the LORD, for He dwells in the height; He has filled Zion with justice and righteousness.
verses.33:6: And He will be the steadiness of your times, a store of salvation, wisdom, and knowledge; the fear of the LORD, that is his treasure.
verses.33:7: Look, their valiant ones cry aloud outside; the messengers of peace weep bitterly.
verses.33:8: The highways stand desolate; the wayfarer has ceased. He has violated the covenant, he has scorned cities, he regards no mortal.
verses.33:9: The land mourns and droops; Lebanon is disgraced and withers; Sharon has become like an arid plain, and Bashan and Carmel shake themselves bare.
verses.33:10: "Now I will rise," says the LORD, "now I will exalt Myself, now I will be lifted up.
verses.33:11: You conceive dry grass, you bear stubble; your breath is a fire that will devour you.
verses.33:12: And peoples will become burnings of lime, cut thorns that will burn in the fire.
verses.33:13: Hear, you who are distant, what I have done; and know, you who are near, My might!"
verses.33:14: Sinners in Zion are in dread; shuddering has gripped the godless: "Who of us can reside with a devouring fire? Who of us can reside with eternal burnings?"
verses.33:15: The one who walks in righteous deeds and speaks with uprightness, who scorns profit from oppressions, who shakes his hands away from grasping a bribe, who closes his ear against hearing of bloodshed, and shuts his eyes against looking at evil;
verses.33:16: he himself will dwell on the heights; strongholds of cliffs will be his high refuge; his bread is given, his water unfailing.
verses.33:17: Your eyes will gaze upon a king in his beauty; they will see a land of far distances.
verses.33:18: Your heart will ponder terror: "Where is the one who counted? Where is the one who weighed? Where is the one who counted the towers?"
verses.33:19: You will not see a fierce people, a people too deep in speech to understand, stammering in tongue with no comprehension.
verses.33:20: Gaze upon Zion, the city of our appointed festival! Your eyes will see Jerusalem, a tranquil dwelling, a tent that will not be moved; its stakes will never be pulled out, and none of its cords will be snapped.
verses.33:21: Instead, there the LORD will be majestic for us, a place of rivers and broad streams; no vessel with oars will travel on it, and no majestic ship will cross it.
verses.33:22: Because the LORD is our judge, the LORD is our lawmaker, the LORD is our king; He Himself will save us.
verses.33:23: Your cords hang slack; they cannot keep the base of their mast secure; they cannot spread a sail. Then abundant booty and spoil will be divided; the lame will plunder the loot.
verses.33:24: And no dweller will say, "I am ill"; the people living in it will have their iniquity forgiven.
verses.34:1: Come near, nations, to hear, and pay close attention, peoples! Let the earth hear, and its fullness, the world and everything that comes forth from it.
verses.34:2: For the LORD has wrath against all the nations, and fury against all their host; He has doomed them to destruction, He has given them to the slaughter.
verses.34:3: And their fallen will be thrown out, and from their corpses their stench will rise, and mountains will dissolve with their blood.
verses.34:4: And all the host of the heavens will decay, and the heavens will be rolled together like a scroll; and all their host will wither, like the withering of a leaf from a vine and like what withers from a fig tree.
verses.34:5: For My sword has been drenched in the heavens; look, it will descend upon Edom, and upon the people I have doomed to destruction, for judgment.
verses.34:6: The LORD has a sword, full of blood, made rich with fat, with the blood of lambs and male goats, with the fat of rams' kidneys; for the LORD holds a sacrifice in Bozrah, and a great slaughter in the land of Edom.
verses.34:7: And wild oxen will go down with them, and young bulls with mighty ones; their land will be drenched with blood, and their dust will be made rich with fat.
verses.34:8: For a day of vengeance belongs to the LORD, a year of retribution for Zion's cause.
verses.34:9: And its streams will be turned to pitch, and its dust to sulfur, and its land will become blazing pitch.
verses.34:10: Night and day it will not go out; forever its smoke will ascend. From generation to generation it will remain waste; for all eternity no one will pass through it.
verses.34:11: The desert owl and the hedgehog will possess it, and the great owl and the raven will dwell in it; and He will stretch out over it the measuring line of formlessness and the plumb stones of emptiness.
verses.34:12: As for its nobles, there is no one there to proclaim a kingdom, and all its officials will come to nothing.
verses.34:13: And thorns will spring up in its citadels, nettles and brambles in its fortresses; it will become a lair of jackals, an enclosure for ostriches.
verses.34:14: And desert beasts will meet with hyenas, and a wild goat will call to its companion; indeed, there the night creature will settle down and find a resting place for herself.
verses.34:15: There the arrow snake will make a nest and lay eggs, and hatch and brood in its shade; indeed, there the kites will be gathered, each with her companion.
verses.34:16: Search from the scroll of the LORD and read: not one of them will be missing; none will lack her companion. For it is My mouth that has commanded, and it is His Spirit who has gathered them.
verses.34:17: And He Himself has cast a lot for them, and His hand has apportioned it to them with the measuring line; forever they will possess it, from generation to generation they will dwell in it.
verses.35:1: The wilderness and the parched ground will be glad, and the arid plain will exult and bloom like a crocus.
verses.35:2: It will bloom richly and exult, yes, with exultation and ringing shouts. The glory of Lebanon is given to it, the splendor of Carmel and Sharon. They themselves will see the glory of the LORD, the splendor of our God.
verses.35:3: Strengthen drooping hands, and make stumbling knees firm.
verses.35:4: Say to those of agitated heart, "Be strong; do not be afraid! Look, your God will come with vengeance, with God's repayment; He Himself will come and save you."
verses.35:5: Then the eyes of the blind will open wide, and the ears of the deaf will be opened.
verses.35:6: Then the lame will bound like a deer, and the tongue of the mute will ring out with joy; for waters will burst out in the wilderness, and streams in the arid plain.
verses.35:7: And the mirage will turn into a pool, and the thirsty land into springs of water; in the lair of jackals, its resting place, grass will become reeds and papyrus.
verses.35:8: And a highway and a road will be there, and it will be called the Way of Holiness. No unclean person will pass over it, but it will be for them; whoever walks the way, even fools, will not stray.
verses.35:9: There will be no lion there, and no predatory beast will climb onto it; none will be found there, but the redeemed will walk on it.
verses.35:10: And those ransomed by the LORD will return and enter Zion with ringing shouts, with eternal joy upon their heads; gladness and joy they will attain, and grief and groaning will flee.
verses.36:1: And it happened in the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah that Sennacherib, king of Assyria, came up against all the fortified cities of Judah and captured them.
verses.36:2: Then the king of Assyria sent Rabshakeh from Lachish to Jerusalem, to King Hezekiah, with a large army. And he stood by the conduit of the upper pool, on the highway of the launderer's field.
verses.36:3: Then Eliakim son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah son of Asaph, the recorder, went out to him.
verses.36:4: And Rabshakeh said to them, "Say now to Hezekiah, 'This is what the great king, the king of Assyria, says: What is this confidence in which you have trusted?
verses.36:5: I say, counsel and strength for war are merely words of the lips. Now in whom have you trusted, that you have rebelled against me?
verses.36:6: Look, you have trusted in the staff of this crushed reed, in Egypt, on which if a man leans, it will go into his palm and pierce it. So is Pharaoh, king of Egypt, to all who trust in him.
verses.36:7: And if you say to me, "We have trusted in the LORD our God," is it not He whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah removed, and said to Judah and to Jerusalem, "Before this altar you shall worship"?
verses.36:8: Now then, make a wager with my master, the king of Assyria, and I will give you two thousand horses, if you are able on your part to put riders on them.
verses.36:9: How then could you turn back even a single governor among the least of my master's servants, while you trust in Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?
verses.36:10: And now, is it apart from the LORD that I have come up against this land to destroy it? The LORD said to me, "Go up against this land and destroy it."'"
verses.36:11: Then Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah said to Rabshakeh, "Please speak to your servants in Aramaic, for we understand it; and do not speak to us in Judean in the hearing of the people who are on the wall."
verses.36:12: But Rabshakeh said, "Has my master sent me to your master and to you to speak these words? Was it not to the men sitting on the wall, who are to eat their own excrement and to drink the water of their feet with you?"
verses.36:13: Then Rabshakeh stood and called out with a loud voice in Judean and said, "Hear the words of the great king, the king of Assyria.
verses.36:14: This is what the king says: 'Do not let Hezekiah deceive you, for he will not be able to rescue you.
verses.36:15: And do not let Hezekiah make you trust in the LORD by saying, "The LORD will certainly rescue us; this city will not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria."'
verses.36:16: Do not listen to Hezekiah, for this is what the king of Assyria says: 'Make peace with me and come out to me, and eat, each one from his own vine and each one from his own fig tree, and drink, each one the water of his own cistern,
verses.36:17: until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of grain and new wine, a land of bread and vineyards.
verses.36:18: Beware that Hezekiah does not mislead you, saying, "The LORD will rescue us." Have the gods of the nations rescued each his own land from the hand of the king of Assyria?
verses.36:19: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arpad? Where are the gods of Sepharvaim? And have they rescued Samaria from my hand?
verses.36:20: Who among all the gods of these lands have rescued their land from my hand, that the LORD should rescue Jerusalem from my hand?'"
verses.36:21: But they kept silent and did not answer him a word, for the king's command was, "Do not answer him."
verses.36:22: Then Eliakim son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah son of Asaph, the recorder, came to Hezekiah with torn garments and reported to him the words of Rabshakeh.
verses.37:1: Now when King Hezekiah heard this, he tore his garments, covered himself with sackcloth, and entered the house of the LORD.
verses.37:2: And he sent Eliakim, who was over the household, Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests, covered with sackcloth, to Isaiah son of Amoz, the prophet.
verses.37:3: And they said to him, "This is what Hezekiah says: This day is a day of distress, rebuke, and contempt; for children have come to the point of birth, and there is no strength to give birth.
verses.37:4: Perhaps the LORD your God will hear the words of Rabshakeh, whom his master, the king of Assyria, has sent to revile the living God, and will rebuke the words that the LORD your God has heard. So lift up a prayer for the remnant that remains."
verses.37:5: So the servants of King Hezekiah came to Isaiah.
verses.37:6: And Isaiah said to them, "This is what you shall say to your master: 'This is what the LORD says: Do not be afraid because of the words that you have heard, with which the attendants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed Me.
verses.37:7: Look, I am putting a spirit in him, and he will hear a report and return to his own land; and I will make him fall by the sword in his own land.'"
verses.37:8: Then Rabshakeh returned and found the king of Assyria fighting against Libnah, for he had heard that he had departed from Lachish.
verses.37:9: Now he heard concerning Tirhakah, king of Cush, "He has come out to fight against you." When he heard it, he sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying,
verses.37:10: "This is what you shall say to Hezekiah, king of Judah: 'Do not let your God, in whom you trust, deceive you by saying, "Jerusalem will not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria."
verses.37:11: Look, you yourself have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all the lands, destroying them completely. And will you be rescued?
verses.37:12: Did the gods of the nations that my fathers destroyed rescue them—Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, and the sons of Eden who were in Telassar?
verses.37:13: Where is the king of Hamath, the king of Arpad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, of Hena, and of Ivvah?'"
verses.37:14: Then Hezekiah took the letter from the hand of the messengers and read it; and he went up to the house of the LORD, and Hezekiah spread it out before the LORD.
verses.37:15: And Hezekiah prayed to the LORD, saying,
verses.37:16: "LORD of hosts, God of Israel, enthroned above the cherubim, You alone are God over all the kingdoms of the earth; You made the heavens and the earth.
verses.37:17: Incline Your ear, LORD, and hear; open Your eyes, LORD, and see; and hear all the words of Sennacherib, which he has sent to revile the living God.
verses.37:18: Truly, LORD, the kings of Assyria have laid waste all the countries and their land,
verses.37:19: and have cast their gods into the fire, for they were not gods, but the work of human hands, wood and stone; so they destroyed them.
verses.37:20: And now, LORD our God, save us from his hand, so that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that You alone are the LORD."
verses.37:21: Then Isaiah son of Amoz sent to Hezekiah, saying, "This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: Because you have prayed to Me concerning Sennacherib, king of Assyria,
verses.37:22: this is the word that the LORD has spoken against him: The virgin daughter of Zion despises you, she mocks you; the daughter of Jerusalem shakes her head behind you.
verses.37:23: Whom have you reviled and blasphemed? Against whom have you raised your voice and lifted your eyes on high? Against the Holy One of Israel!
verses.37:24: By the hand of your servants you have reviled the Lord, and you have said, 'With my many chariots I have gone up to the height of the mountains, to the far recesses of Lebanon; I will cut down its tallest cedars, the choicest of its cypresses, and I will come to its farthest height, its lush forest.
verses.37:25: I dug wells and drank water, and with the sole of my feet I will dry up all the streams of Egypt.'
verses.37:26: Have you not heard? Long ago I did it; from days of old I formed it. Now I have brought it about, that you should turn fortified cities into heaps of ruins.
verses.37:27: And their inhabitants, of little strength, were dismayed and put to shame; they became plants of the field and tender green shoots, grass on the rooftops and a field before the standing grain.
verses.37:28: But I know your sitting down, your going out, and your coming in, and your raging against Me.
verses.37:29: Because of your raging against Me, and because your arrogance has come up into My ears, I will put My hook in your nose and My bridle in your lips, and I will turn you back along the way by which you came.
verses.37:30: And this shall be the sign for you: this year you shall eat what grows of itself, and in the second year what springs from that; and in the third year sow and reap, plant vineyards and eat their fruit.
verses.37:31: And the survivors of the house of Judah who remain will again take root downward and bear fruit upward.
verses.37:32: For out of Jerusalem a remnant will go forth, and survivors from Mount Zion. The zeal of the LORD of hosts will accomplish this.
verses.37:33: Therefore this is what the LORD says concerning the king of Assyria: He will not enter this city, nor shoot an arrow there, nor confront it with a shield, nor heap up a siege ramp against it.
verses.37:34: By the way that he came, he will return, and he will not enter this city, declares the LORD.
verses.37:35: And I will defend this city to save it, for My own sake and for the sake of My servant David."
verses.37:36: Then the angel of the LORD went out and struck down one hundred eighty-five thousand in the camp of Assyria; and when they rose early in the morning, look, all of them were dead bodies.
verses.37:37: So Sennacherib, king of Assyria, departed, went away, and returned, and he lived in Nineveh.
verses.37:38: And it happened as he was worshiping in the house of Nisroch his god that Adrammelech and Sharezer, his sons, struck him down with the sword, and they escaped to the land of Ararat. And Esarhaddon his son became king in his place.
verses.38:1: In those days Hezekiah became sick to the point of death, and Isaiah son of Amoz, the prophet, came to him and said to him, "This is what the LORD says: 'Give instructions for your household, for you are dying and will not live.'"
verses.38:2: Hezekiah turned his face toward the wall and prayed to the LORD.
verses.38:3: He said, "Please, LORD, remember now how I have walked before You in faithfulness and with a complete heart, and have done what is good in Your eyes." Then Hezekiah wept with great weeping.
verses.38:4: Now the word of the LORD came to Isaiah, saying,
verses.38:5: "Go and speak to Hezekiah: 'This is what the LORD, the God of David your father, says: I have heard your prayer; I have seen your tears. Look, I am adding fifteen years to your days.
verses.38:6: And from the grasp of the king of Assyria I will rescue you and this city, and I will shield this city.
verses.38:7: And this is the sign for you from the LORD that the LORD will carry out this matter that He has spoken:
verses.38:8: Look, I am making the shadow of the steps, which has gone down on the steps of Ahaz with the sun, go back ten steps.'" So the sun went back ten steps on the steps that it had gone down.
verses.38:9: A writing of Hezekiah, king of Judah, when he fell sick and recovered from his sickness:
verses.38:10: I said, "At the midpoint of my days I must pass through the gates of Sheol; I have been deprived of the remainder of my years."
verses.38:11: I said, "I will not see the LORD, the LORD in the land of the living; I will gaze on humanity no more among the dwellers of the fleeting world."
verses.38:12: My dwelling has been pulled up and carried away from me like a shepherd's tent; I have rolled up my life like a weaver; from the loom He severs me. From day until night You put an end to me.
verses.38:13: I calmed myself until morning; like a lion, so He shatters all my bones. From day until night You put an end to me.
verses.38:14: Like a swift or a crane, so I twitter; I moan like a dove. My eyes grow dim toward the height. Lord, distress is upon me; stand as my surety!
verses.38:15: What can I speak? He has spoken to me, and He Himself has acted. I will tread slowly all my years on account of the bitterness of my soul.
verses.38:16: Lord, by these things people live, and wholly in them is the life of my spirit; restore me to health and make me live!
verses.38:17: Look, it was for peace that bitterness upon bitterness came to me; yet You have lovingly kept my soul from the pit of nothingness, for You have thrown all my sins behind Your back.
verses.38:18: For Sheol does not give You thanks, nor does death praise You; those who descend to the pit do not hope for Your faithfulness.
verses.38:19: The living, the living, he is the one who gives You thanks, just as I do today; a father makes Your faithfulness known to children.
verses.38:20: The LORD is ready to save me; so we will play my stringed music all the days of our lives at the house of the LORD.
verses.38:21: And Isaiah said, "Let them take a cake of figs and rub it on the boil, so that he may recover."
verses.38:22: And Hezekiah said, "What sign is there that I will go up to the house of the LORD?"
verses.39:1: At that time Merodach-baladan son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a gift to Hezekiah, for he heard that he had fallen sick and had grown strong again.
verses.39:2: Hezekiah rejoiced over them and showed them his treasure house, the silver, the gold, the spices, and the fine oil, as well as his entire armory and everything found in his treasuries. There was not a thing in his house or in all his realm that Hezekiah did not show them.
verses.39:3: Then the prophet Isaiah came to King Hezekiah and said to him, "What did these men say, and where do they come from to you?" And Hezekiah said, "From a distant land they have come to me, from Babylon."
verses.39:4: He said, "What did they see in your house?" Hezekiah said, "Everything that is in my house they saw; there was not a thing in my treasuries that I did not show them."
verses.39:5: Isaiah then said to Hezekiah, "Listen to the word of the LORD of hosts:
verses.39:6: Look, days are coming when everything in your house and what your fathers have stored up until this day will be carried off to Babylon; nothing will remain, says the LORD.
verses.39:7: And some of your sons who come forth from you, whom you will father, will be taken, and they will become eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon."
verses.39:8: Then Hezekiah said to Isaiah, "Good is the word of the LORD that you have spoken." And he said, "For there will be peace and truth in my days."
verses.40:1: "Comfort, comfort My people," your God says.
verses.40:2: "Speak to the heart of Jerusalem and call out to her that her hard service has been fulfilled, that her iniquity has been paid off, that she has received from the hand of the LORD double for all her sins."
verses.40:3: A voice calls out: "In the wilderness clear the way of the LORD; level in the desert plain a highway for our God.
verses.40:4: Every valley will be raised up, and every mountain and hill will become low; the uneven ground will become a level plain, and the rugged ridges a broad valley.
verses.40:5: The glory of the LORD will be unveiled, and all flesh together will see it, because the mouth of the LORD has spoken."
verses.40:6: A voice says, "Call out!" And he said, "What shall I call out?" "All flesh is grass, and all its loyal love is like a blossom of the field.
verses.40:7: The grass dries up, the blossom wilts, when the breath of the LORD blows across it; indeed, the people are grass.
verses.40:8: The grass dries up, the blossom wilts, yet the word of our God stands forever."
verses.40:9: Go up onto a high mountain, Zion, messenger of good news; raise your voice with strength, Jerusalem, messenger of good news; raise it up, do not be afraid! Say to the cities of Judah, "Here is your God!"
verses.40:10: See, the Lord GOD is coming with strength, and His arm rules for Him; look, His reward is with Him, and His recompense is ahead of Him.
verses.40:11: Like a shepherd He tends His flock; with His arm He gathers the lambs and carries them against His chest; the nursing ewes He gently guides.
verses.40:12: Who has measured waters in His cupped hand, and gauged the heavens with a span, and held the dust of the earth in a measure, and weighed mountains with a balance and hills on scales?
verses.40:13: Who has gauged the Spirit of the LORD, or as His counselor instructed Him?
verses.40:14: Whom did He consult to give Him understanding, to teach Him in the path of justice, to teach Him knowledge, and to make known to Him the way of understanding?
verses.40:15: Look, the nations are like a drop from a bucket, and like fine dust on the scales they are reckoned; look, He lifts the coastlands like a speck of dust.
verses.40:16: Lebanon is not enough for burning, nor are its wild animals enough for a burnt offering.
verses.40:17: All the nations are like nothing in His presence; as less than nothing and emptiness they are reckoned by Him.
verses.40:18: To whom then will you liken God, and what likeness will you set alongside Him?
verses.40:19: As for an idol, a craftsman casts it, and a metalworker plates it with gold and casts chains of silver.
verses.40:20: The one too poor for an offering picks wood that will not decay; he searches for a skilled craftsman to set up an idol that will not topple.
verses.40:21: Do you not know? Do you not hear? Was it not declared to you from the beginning? Have you not understood the foundations of the earth?
verses.40:22: He is the One who sits enthroned above the circle of the earth, and its dwellers are like grasshoppers; who stretches out the heavens like a thin veil and spreads them like a tent to dwell in.
verses.40:23: He is the One who reduces princes to nothing, and makes the judges of the earth like emptiness.
verses.40:24: Barely have they been planted, barely have they been sown, barely has their stem taken root in the earth, when He blows upon them and they dry up, and a stormwind carries them away like stubble.
verses.40:25: "To whom then will you liken Me, that I might be equal?" says the Holy One.
verses.40:26: Raise your eyes to the height and see: who created these? He is the One who brings out their host by number; He calls all of them by name. Because of the abundance of His vigor, and because He is mighty in strength, not a single one is missing.
verses.40:27: Why do you say, Jacob, and speak, Israel, "My way is concealed from the LORD, and my justice passes away from my God"?
verses.40:28: Have you not known, or have you not heard? The eternal God, the LORD, Creator of the ends of the earth, does not grow weary and does not become exhausted; there is no searching out His understanding.
verses.40:29: He gives strength to the weary, and to the one without vigor He multiplies power.
verses.40:30: Even youths grow weary and become exhausted, and young men utterly stumble;
verses.40:31: but those who wait for the LORD will gain fresh strength; they will ascend on wings like eagles; they will run and not become exhausted; they will walk and not grow weary.
verses.41:1: Keep silent before Me, coastlands, and let the peoples regain their strength. Let them step forward, then let them speak; together let us draw near for judgment.
verses.41:2: Who has roused one from the east, whom He calls in righteousness to follow Him? He hands over nations before him and subdues kings; He makes them like dust with his sword, like blown stubble with his bow.
verses.41:3: He pursues them and passes on in safety, along a path he has not gone with his feet.
verses.41:4: Who has acted and done this, summoning the generations from the beginning? I, the LORD, am the first, and with the last ones, I am He.
verses.41:5: The coastlands saw and became afraid; the ends of the earth shuddered; they drew near and came.
verses.41:6: Each man helps his neighbor, and to his brother he says, "Be strong!"
verses.41:7: The artisan strengthens the metalworker, and the one who smooths with the hammer strengthens the one who strikes the anvil, saying about the soldering, "It is good"; and he secures it with nails so that it will not topple.
verses.41:8: Yet you, Israel, My servant, Jacob whom I chose, seed of Abraham, My friend,
verses.41:9: you whom I took hold of from the ends of the earth and summoned from its remote corners, and I said to you, "You are My servant; I chose you and did not reject you."
verses.41:10: Do not be afraid, for I am with you; do not look about in alarm, for I am your God. I will make you strong; indeed, I will help you; indeed, I will support you with the right hand of My righteousness.
verses.41:11: Look, all who are furious with you will be ashamed and disgraced; the men who contend with you will be like nothing and will perish.
verses.41:12: You will search for them and not find them, the men who quarrel with you; the men who wage war against you will be like nothing and like nonexistence.
verses.41:13: For I am the LORD your God, who grasps your right hand, who says to you, "Do not be afraid; I Myself will help you."
verses.41:14: Do not be afraid, worm of Jacob, men of Israel; I Myself will help you, declares the LORD, and your Redeemer is the Holy One of Israel.
verses.41:15: Look, I have made you into a sharp new threshing sledge with many teeth; you will thresh mountains and crush them fine, and the hills you will make like chaff.
verses.41:16: You will winnow them, and a wind will lift them away, and a whirlwind will scatter them. Yet you will exult in the LORD; in the Holy One of Israel you will boast.
verses.41:17: The afflicted and the needy search for water, and there is none; their tongue is dried up with thirst. I, the LORD, will answer them; I, the God of Israel, will not abandon them.
verses.41:18: I will open rivers on bare heights and fountains in the middle of valleys; I will turn the wilderness into a pool of water and parched land into wellsprings of water.
verses.41:19: I will place in the wilderness the cedar, the acacia, the myrtle, and the oil tree; I will set in the desert plain the cypress, the elm, and the box tree together,
verses.41:20: so that they may see and know, and lay it to heart and perceive together, that the hand of the LORD has done this, and the Holy One of Israel has created it.
verses.41:21: "Bring near your case," says the LORD. "Present your strong arguments," says the King of Jacob.
verses.41:22: Let them bring them forward and declare to us what will happen. As for the former things, what are they? Declare them, so that we may set our minds on them and know their outcome; or let us hear the things to come.
verses.41:23: Declare the things that are coming afterward, so that we may know that you are gods; indeed, do good or do harm, so that we may be alarmed and look on together.
verses.41:24: Look, you are less than nothing, and your work is less than nothingness; an abomination is the one who chooses you.
verses.41:25: I have roused one from the north, and he has come; from the rising of the sun he will call on My name. He will come upon governors as upon mortar, just as a potter tramples clay.
verses.41:26: Who declared this from the beginning, so that we might know, and from earlier times, so that we might say, "He is right"? Indeed, there is no one who declares; indeed, there is no one who proclaims; indeed, there is no one who hears your words.
verses.41:27: I first said to Zion, "Look, here they are!" and to Jerusalem I will give one who brings good news.
verses.41:28: I look, and there is no one; and among these there is no counselor who, when I question them, can return a reply.
verses.41:29: Look, all of them are futility; their deeds are nothing; their cast images are wind and emptiness.
verses.42:1: Here is My servant, whom I support, My chosen one, in whom My soul takes pleasure. I have placed My Spirit upon him; he will bring forth justice for the nations.
verses.42:2: He will not shout, nor raise his voice, nor cause his voice to be heard in the street.
verses.42:3: He will not break a crushed reed, nor extinguish a dim wick; in truth he will bring forth justice.
verses.42:4: He will not grow dim nor be crushed until he establishes justice on the earth; and the coastlands wait in hope for his instruction.
verses.42:5: This is what God, the LORD, says, the Creator of the heavens who stretches them out, the One who spreads out the earth and what springs from it, who gives breath to the people upon it and spirit to those who walk in it:
verses.42:6: "I, the LORD, have summoned you in righteousness; I will take hold of your hand, I will guard you, and I will give you as a covenant for the people, as a light to the nations,
verses.42:7: to open blind eyes, to bring a prisoner out of the dungeon, and from the prison house those who dwell in darkness.
verses.42:8: I am the LORD; that is My name. My glory I will not give to another, nor My praise to carved images.
verses.42:9: Look, the former things have come about, and new things I am declaring; before they sprout forth, I announce them to you."
verses.42:10: Sing a new song to the LORD, His praise from the end of the earth, you who go down to the sea and its fullness, you coastlands and their inhabitants.
verses.42:11: Let the wilderness and its cities raise their voice, the settlements where Kedar dwells; let the residents of Sela sing for joy; from the top of the mountains let them shout aloud.
verses.42:12: Let them ascribe glory to the LORD, and in the coastlands declare His praise.
verses.42:13: The LORD will go out like a mighty warrior; like a man of battles He will stir up zeal. He will shout a war cry, indeed He will roar aloud; against His enemies He will prove Himself mighty.
verses.42:14: From long ago I have kept silent; I remained quiet and restrained Myself. Like a woman giving birth I will cry out; I will gasp and pant together.
verses.42:15: I will make mountains and hills desolate, and all their vegetation I will dry up; I will turn rivers into islands, and pools I will dry up.
verses.42:16: And I will lead the blind along a road they have not known; on paths they have not known I will guide them. I will make the darkness before them into light, and crooked places into level ground. These are the things: I will do them, and I will not abandon them.
verses.42:17: They are turned back, they will be put to utter shame, those who trust in a carved image, who say to a cast image, "You are our gods."
verses.42:18: You deaf ones, hear! And you blind ones, look so that you may see!
verses.42:19: Who is blind except My servant, or deaf like My messenger whom I send? Who is blind like the one at peace, or blind like the servant of the LORD?
verses.42:20: Seeing many things, yet you do not observe them; opening the ears, yet he does not hear.
verses.42:21: The LORD was pleased, for the sake of His righteousness, to make instruction great and glorious.
verses.42:22: Yet it is a people plundered and despoiled; all of them are ensnared in holes, and in prison houses they have been hidden away. They have become plunder with no one to deliver, and spoil with no one saying, "Give it back!"
verses.42:23: Which of you will give ear to this, pay attention and hear for the time to come?
verses.42:24: Who gave Jacob over as spoil, and Israel to plunderers? Was it not the LORD, the One against whom we have sinned, in whose ways they were unwilling to walk, and to whose instruction they did not listen?
verses.42:25: So He poured out upon him the fury of His anger and the might of war; it set him ablaze on every side, yet he did not realize it; it burned him, yet he would not lay it to heart.
verses.43:1: But now, this is what the LORD says—He who created you, Jacob, and He who formed you, Israel: "Do not be afraid, for I have redeemed you; I have called you by your name; you belong to Me.
verses.43:2: When you cross through the waters, I am with you, and through the rivers, they will not flood over you; when you walk through fire, you will not be scorched, and flame will not burn against you.
verses.43:3: For I am the LORD your God, the Holy One of Israel, your Savior. I have given Egypt as a ransom for you, Cush and Seba instead of you.
verses.43:4: Because you are precious in My eyes, you are honored, and I love you, I will give people instead of you and nations in place of your life.
verses.43:5: Do not be afraid, for I am with you; from the east I will bring your seed, and from the west I will gather you.
verses.43:6: I will say to the north, 'Give them up,' and to the south, 'Do not hold back! Bring My sons from afar and My daughters from the end of the earth,
verses.43:7: everyone who is called by My name, whom I created for My glory, whom I formed—indeed, whom I made.'"
verses.43:8: "Bring out the people who are blind, though they have eyes, and the deaf, though they have ears.
verses.43:9: Let all the nations gather together, and let the peoples assemble. Who among them can declare this and announce the former things to us? Let them present their witnesses that they may be proved right, and let them hear and say, 'It is true.'
verses.43:10: You are My witnesses," declares the LORD, "and My servant whom I chose, in order that you may know, trust Me, and discern that I am He. Before Me no god was formed, and after Me none will exist.
verses.43:11: I—I am the LORD, and there is no savior apart from Me.
verses.43:12: I Myself declared, saved, and proclaimed, when there was no foreign god in your midst; so you are My witnesses," declares the LORD, "and I am God.
verses.43:13: Even from the first day I am He, and no one can rescue from My hand; I act, and who can turn it back?"
verses.43:14: This is what the LORD, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel, says: "For your sake I have sent to Babylon, and I will bring all of them down as fugitives, even the Chaldeans, in the ships of their jubilation.
verses.43:15: I am the LORD, your Holy One, the Creator of Israel, your King."
verses.43:16: This is what the LORD says, who sets a way in the sea and a path in mighty waters,
verses.43:17: who leads out chariot and horse, army and mighty force—they lie down together, they will not rise; they are snuffed out, quenched like a wick:
verses.43:18: "Do not recall the former things, and do not reflect upon the things of long ago.
verses.43:19: Look, I am doing something new; now it sprouts forth—do you not recognize it? Indeed, I will set a way in the wilderness and rivers in the wasteland.
verses.43:20: The wild beasts of the field will honor Me, the jackals and the ostriches, because I have given water in the wilderness and rivers in the wasteland, to give drink to My people, My chosen one,
verses.43:21: the people whom I formed for Myself; they will recount My praise.
verses.43:22: Yet you did not call upon Me, Jacob; instead, you have grown weary of Me, Israel.
verses.43:23: You have not brought Me the sheep of your burnt offerings, nor have you honored Me with your sacrifices; I have not burdened you with a grain offering, nor have I wearied you with frankincense.
verses.43:24: You have not bought Me sweet cane with silver, nor have you satisfied Me with the fat of your sacrifices. Instead, you have burdened Me with your sins; you have wearied Me with your iniquities.
verses.43:25: I—I am He who wipes out your transgressions for My own sake, and your sins I will not remember.
verses.43:26: Remind Me; let us contend in judgment together. Recount your case yourself, so that you may be vindicated.
verses.43:27: Your first father sinned, and your mediators rebelled against Me.
verses.43:28: Therefore I will profane the officials of the sanctuary, and I will give Jacob to utter destruction and Israel to reviling."
verses.44:1: "But now listen, Jacob My servant, and Israel, whom I have chosen."
verses.44:2: This is what the LORD says, who made you and formed you from the womb, who will help you: "Do not be afraid, My servant Jacob, and Jeshurun, whom I have chosen.
verses.44:3: For I will pour out water upon thirsty ground and flowing streams upon the dry land; I will pour out My Spirit upon your seed and My blessing upon your descendants.
verses.44:4: They will sprout among the grass, like willows along channels of water.
verses.44:5: One will say, 'I belong to the LORD,' and another will call himself by the name of Jacob; still another will write on his hand, 'Belonging to the LORD,' and title himself by the name of Israel."
verses.44:6: This is what the LORD, the King of Israel and his Redeemer, the LORD of hosts, says: "I am first and I am last, and apart from Me there is no God.
verses.44:7: Who is like Me? Let him proclaim it, declare it, and set it in order before Me, from the time I established an ancient people; and let them declare to them the things to come and what will arrive.
verses.44:8: Do not tremble and do not be terrified. Have I not announced to you from long ago and declared it? You are My witnesses! Is there a God apart from Me? There is no Rock; I know of none."
verses.44:9: All who form an idol are emptiness, and their prized things cannot profit; and their witnesses themselves neither see nor know, so that they will be put to shame.
verses.44:10: Who has formed a god or cast an idol that is of no profit?
verses.44:11: Look, all his companions will be put to shame, for the craftsmen are merely human. Let them all assemble and take their stand; they will tremble and be put to shame together.
verses.44:12: The ironsmith works a cutting tool over the coals; he forms it with hammers and works it with his strong arm. Yet he becomes hungry and has no strength; he drinks no water and grows faint.
verses.44:13: The woodworker stretches out a line; he outlines it with a stylus, shapes it with planes, and outlines it with a compass. He makes it in the form of a man, with the beauty of a human being, to dwell in a house.
verses.44:14: He cuts down cedars for himself, and takes a cypress and an oak, and lets it grow strong for himself among the trees of the forest. He plants a pine, and the rain makes it grow.
verses.44:15: Then it becomes something for a man to burn; he takes some of it and warms himself. He also kindles a fire and bakes bread; he also fashions a god and bows down to it—he makes it an idol and falls prostrate before it.
verses.44:16: Half of it he burns in the fire; over half of it he eats meat—he roasts a roast and is satisfied. He also warms himself and says, "Aha, I am warm! I have seen the fire!"
verses.44:17: The rest of it he makes into a god, his idol; he falls prostrate before it and bows down, and he prays to it and says, "Rescue me, for you are my god!"
verses.44:18: They do not know and they do not understand, for their eyes have been plastered shut from seeing, and their hearts from comprehending.
verses.44:19: He does not take it to heart, nor is there knowledge or discernment to say, "Half of it I burned in the fire; I also baked bread over its coals, roasted meat, and ate it. Shall I make the rest of it into an abomination? Shall I fall prostrate before a block of wood?"
verses.44:20: He feeds on ashes; a deluded heart has led him astray, so that he cannot rescue his own life, nor say, "Is there not a lie in my right hand?"
verses.44:21: "Remember these things, Jacob, and Israel, because you are My servant; I formed you, you are a servant to Me—Israel, you will not be forgotten by Me.
verses.44:22: Like a thick cloud I have wiped out your transgressions, and like a cloud your sins; turn back to Me, for I have redeemed you."
verses.44:23: Sing for joy, heavens, for the LORD has acted! Shout aloud, depths of the earth! Break forth into joyful song, mountains, forest, and every tree in it! For the LORD has redeemed Jacob, and in Israel He will glorify Himself.
verses.44:24: This is what the LORD, your Redeemer and He who formed you from the womb, says: "I am the LORD, who makes all things, who stretches out the heavens alone, who spreads out the earth by Myself;
verses.44:25: who nullifies the signs of liars and turns diviners into fools, who sends the wise backward and renders their knowledge foolish;
verses.44:26: who confirms the word of His servant and fulfills the counsel of His messengers; who says of Jerusalem, 'She will be inhabited,' and of the cities of Judah, 'They will be built,' and I will raise up her ruins;
verses.44:27: who says to the deep, 'Be dry, and I will dry up your rivers';
verses.44:28: who says of Cyrus, 'He is My shepherd, and he will fulfill all My desire,' and saying of Jerusalem, 'She will be built,' and of the temple, 'Its foundation will be laid.'"
verses.45:1: This is what the LORD says to His anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have taken hold of to subdue nations before him, and I will unfasten the loins of kings, to open double doors before him, and gates will not be shut:
verses.45:2: "I Myself will go before you and make the rugged terrain level; doors of bronze I will shatter, and bars of iron I will hew through.
verses.45:3: And I will give you treasures of darkness and hidden stores of secret places, so that you may know that I am the LORD, who calls you by your name, the God of Israel.
verses.45:4: For the sake of My servant Jacob, and Israel My chosen one, I called you by your name; I designate you by an honored title, even though you do not know Me.
verses.45:5: I am the LORD, and there is no other; apart from Me there is no God. I gird you, even though you do not know Me,
verses.45:6: so that they may know from the rising of the sun and from the west that there is none apart from Me; I am the LORD, and there is no other,
verses.45:7: forming light and creating darkness, making peace and creating disaster; I, the LORD, am the One who does all of these.
verses.45:8: Shower down, heavens, from above, and let the skies pour out righteousness; let the earth open up so that they bear salvation as fruit, and let it cause righteousness to sprout together; I, the LORD, have created it."
verses.45:9: Woe to the one who quarrels with his Maker—a potsherd among the potsherds of the ground! Will clay say to the one who forms it, "What are you making?" or, "Your work has no hands"?
verses.45:10: Woe to the one who says to a father, "What are you fathering?" or to a woman, "With what are you in labor?"
verses.45:11: This is what the LORD, the Holy One of Israel and his Maker, says: "Ask Me about the things to come; concerning My sons and concerning the work of My hands, will you command Me?
verses.45:12: It is I who made the earth, and I created mankind upon it; My own hands stretched out the heavens, and all their host I commanded.
verses.45:13: It is I who stirred him up in righteousness, and all his ways I will make level; he will build My city and release My exiles, not for a price and not for a bribe," says the LORD of hosts.
verses.45:14: This is what the LORD says: "The earnings of Egypt and the trade of Cush, and the Sabeans, men of stature, will pass over to you and will be yours; behind you they will walk, in chains they will pass over, and to you they will bow down; to you they will plead, 'Surely God is in you, and there is no other; there is no god besides.'"
verses.45:15: Indeed, You are a God who hides Himself, God of Israel, Savior.
verses.45:16: They have been put to shame and also humiliated, all of them; together they have gone off in humiliation, the craftsmen of idols.
verses.45:17: Israel has been saved by the LORD with an everlasting salvation; you will not be put to shame and you will not be humiliated for all eternity.
verses.45:18: For this is what the LORD says, Creator of the heavens—He is God—who formed the earth and made it; He established it; He did not create it a wasteland, He formed it to be inhabited: "I am the LORD, and there is no other.
verses.45:19: I have not spoken in secret, in a place of a land of darkness; I did not say to the seed of Jacob, 'Seek Me in vain.' I, the LORD, speak righteousness, declaring things that are upright.
verses.45:20: Gather yourselves and come, draw near together, survivors of the nations! They have no knowledge, those who carry the wood of their carved image and pray to a god that does not save.
verses.45:21: Declare and bring it forward; indeed, let them take counsel together! Who proclaimed this from ancient times, declared it from long ago? Was it not I, the LORD? And there is no other God besides Me, a righteous God and a Savior; there is none apart from Me.
verses.45:22: Turn toward Me and be saved, all the farthest bounds of the earth, because I am God, and there is no other.
verses.45:23: By Myself I have sworn; a word has gone out from My mouth in righteousness and it will not turn back: that to Me every knee will bend, every tongue will swear.
verses.45:24: 'Only in the LORD,' one will say of Me, 'are righteousness and strength.'" To Him they will come and be put to shame, all who are incensed against Him.
verses.45:25: In the LORD all the seed of Israel will be vindicated and will glory.
verses.46:1: Bel has bent down, Nebo stoops; their idols are put on beasts and on livestock; what you carry is loaded up, a burden for the weary animal.
verses.46:2: They stooped, they bent down together; they were unable to rescue the burden, and they themselves have gone off into captivity.
verses.46:3: Listen to Me, house of Jacob, and all the remnant of the house of Israel, who have been borne from birth, who have been carried from the womb:
verses.46:4: And until old age I am He, and until gray hair I Myself will bear you; I made you, and I will carry you; I Myself will bear you and rescue you.
verses.46:5: To whom will you liken Me and make Me equal, and compare Me, so that we should be alike?
verses.46:6: Those who pour out gold from a bag and weigh out silver on the scale hire a metalworker, and he makes it into a god; they fall down, yes, they bow in worship.
verses.46:7: They lift it onto a shoulder, they bear it, and they set it down in its place, and it stands there; from its place it does not move. Even if one cries out to it, it does not answer; from his distress it does not save him.
verses.46:8: Remember this and be resolute; bring it back to heart, you rebels.
verses.46:9: Remember the former things from long ago, because I am God, and there is no other—God, and there is none like Me,
verses.46:10: declaring the outcome from the beginning, and from earliest times things that have not been done, saying, "My counsel will stand, and all My delight I will carry out,"
verses.46:11: calling a bird of prey from the east, from a distant land the man of My counsel. Indeed I have spoken, indeed I will bring it about; I have formed it, indeed I will do it.
verses.46:12: Listen to Me, you stubborn of heart, who are far from righteousness:
verses.46:13: I have brought My righteousness near; it will not be far off, and My salvation will not delay. And I will grant salvation in Zion, for Israel My splendor.
verses.47:1: Come down and sit on the dust, virgin daughter of Babylon; sit on the ground without a throne, daughter of the Chaldeans! For no longer will they call you "Tender and Pampered."
verses.47:2: Take millstones and grind flour; uncover your veil, strip off the skirt, uncover the leg, cross over rivers.
verses.47:3: Your nakedness will be uncovered, and your disgrace will also be seen; I will take vengeance, and I will spare no human.
verses.47:4: Our Redeemer—the LORD of hosts is His name—is the Holy One of Israel.
verses.47:5: Sit in silence and go into the darkness, daughter of the Chaldeans! For no longer will they call you "Mistress of Kingdoms."
verses.47:6: I was angry with My people; I profaned My inheritance and gave them into your hand. You showed them no compassion; on the aged you made your yoke exceedingly heavy.
verses.47:7: And you said, "Forever I will be a mistress," so that you did not lay these things to your heart; you did not remember its outcome.
verses.47:8: And now, listen to this, you lover of luxury, who sits securely, who says in her heart, "I am, and there is no one besides me; I will not sit as a widow, and I will not know the loss of children."
verses.47:9: Both of these things will come to you in a moment, in a single day: loss of children and widowhood. In full measure they will come upon you, in spite of your many sorceries, in spite of the exceeding power of your spells.
verses.47:10: You trusted in your wickedness; you said, "No one sees me." Your wisdom and your knowledge—it is they that led you astray; and you said in your heart, "I am, and there is no one besides me."
verses.47:11: So disaster will come upon you that you will not know how to charm away; and ruin will fall upon you that you will not be able to buy off; and devastation will come upon you suddenly that you do not know.
verses.47:12: Stand fast now with your spells and with your many sorceries, in which you have labored from your youth; perhaps you will be able to profit, perhaps you will strike terror.
verses.47:13: You have grown weary with your many counsels; let them stand up now and save you—those who divide the heavens, who gaze at the stars, who make known at the new moons what will come upon you.
verses.47:14: Look, they have become like stubble; fire has burned them up. They cannot deliver themselves from the grip of the flame; it is no coal for warming oneself, no fire to sit before!
verses.47:15: Such have they become to you with whom you have labored, your traders from your youth: each one has wandered off in his own direction; there is no one to save you.
verses.48:1: Hear this, house of Jacob, who are called by the name of Israel and came forth from the waters of Judah, who swear by the name of the LORD and make mention of the God of Israel, not in truth and not in righteousness.
verses.48:2: For they are called after the holy city and rely on the God of Israel; the LORD of hosts is His name.
verses.48:3: The former things I declared from long ago; out of My mouth they went forth, and I made them heard. Suddenly I acted, and they came about.
verses.48:4: Because I knew that you are stubborn, and your neck is a sinew of iron and your forehead is bronze,
verses.48:5: I declared it to you from long ago; before it came about I made you hear it, so that you would not say, "My idol made them, and my carved image and my cast image commanded them."
verses.48:6: You have heard; see all of it. And as for you, will you not declare it? From now on I cause you to hear new things, secret things that you have not known.
verses.48:7: Now they are created, and not from long ago; and before today you did not hear them, so that you would not say, "Look, I knew them."
verses.48:8: You have neither heard nor known, nor from long ago has your ear opened; for I knew that you would indeed act treacherously, and you were called a transgressor from the womb.
verses.48:9: For My name's sake I delay My anger, and for My praise I curb it for you, so as not to cut you off.
verses.48:10: Look, I have refined you, though not as silver; I have tested you in the smelting furnace of affliction.
verses.48:11: For My own sake, for My own sake, I will act; for how could it be profaned? And I will not give My glory to another.
verses.48:12: Listen to Me, Jacob, and Israel, My called one: I am He; I am the first, and also I am the last.
verses.48:13: Indeed, My hand laid the foundation of the earth, and My right hand spread out the heavens; I call to them, and they stand up together.
verses.48:14: Gather together, all of you, and listen! Who among them has declared these things? The LORD loves him; he will do His pleasure on Babylon, and His arm will be against the Chaldeans.
verses.48:15: I, I Myself have spoken; yes, I have called him. I have brought him, and his way will succeed.
verses.48:16: Come close to Me, hear this: from the start I did not speak in secret; from the time it came to be, there I was. And now the Lord GOD has sent me, and His Spirit.
verses.48:17: This is what the LORD, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel, says: "I am the LORD your God, who teaches you for your benefit, who guides you in the way you should walk.
verses.48:18: If only you had given heed to My commandments, then your peace would have been like a river and your righteousness like the waves of the sea;
verses.48:19: and your seed would have been like the sand, and the descendants from your body like its grains; its name would not be cut off or destroyed from before Me."
verses.48:20: Go out from Babylon, flee from the Chaldeans! With a voice of joyful shouting declare it, make this heard, send it forth to the end of the earth; say, "The LORD has redeemed His servant Jacob."
verses.48:21: They did not become thirsty when He led them through the waste places; He caused water to stream from the rock for them; He split open the rock, and water gushed out.
verses.48:22: "There is no peace," the LORD says, "for the wicked."
verses.49:1: Hear me, coastlands, and give heed, peoples from afar: the LORD called me from the womb; from my mother's body He made mention of my name.
verses.49:2: He has made my mouth like a sharp sword; in the shadow of His hand He hid me. He set me as a polished arrow; in His quiver He concealed me.
verses.49:3: And He said to me, "You are My servant, Israel, in whom I will display My splendor."
verses.49:4: But I said, "For nothing I have toiled; for emptiness and vapor I have used up my strength. Yet certainly my justice is with the LORD, and my reward is with my God."
verses.49:5: And now the LORD says, the One who formed me from the womb to be a servant to Him, to bring Jacob back to Him and for Israel to be gathered to Him—and I am honored in the eyes of the LORD, and my God has become my strength—
verses.49:6: He says, "It is too light a matter for you to be My servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob and to bring back the preserved ones of Israel; I will also give you as a light to the nations, to be My salvation to the end of the earth."
verses.49:7: This is what the LORD, the Redeemer of Israel and its Holy One, says to one despised in soul, to one loathed by a nation, to a servant of rulers: "Kings will see and rise up, princes also will bow low, for the sake of the LORD, who is faithful, the Holy One of Israel, and He has chosen you."
verses.49:8: This is what the LORD says: "In a time of favor I answered you, and on a day of salvation I helped you; I will preserve you and give you as a covenant for the people, to raise up the land, to allot the desolate inheritances,
verses.49:9: saying to the prisoners, 'Go out,' and to those in darkness, 'Reveal yourselves.' Along the roads they will graze, and on all bare heights will be their pasture.
verses.49:10: They will not be hungry and will not be thirsty, nor will scorching heat or sun strike them; for the One who has compassion on them will lead them, and beside springs of water He will guide them.
verses.49:11: And I will make all My mountains into a road, and My highways will be lifted high.
verses.49:12: Look, these will come from afar; and see, these from the north and from the west, and these from the land of Sinim."
verses.49:13: Ring out with joy, heavens, and exult, earth, and burst forth, mountains, into a joyful shout! For the LORD has comforted His people and will show compassion to His afflicted ones.
verses.49:14: Yet Zion said, "The LORD has abandoned me, and the Lord has forgotten me."
verses.49:15: Can a woman forget her nursing infant, without having compassion on the son of her womb? Even these may forget, yet I Myself will not forget you.
verses.49:16: See, on My palms I have engraved you; your walls are constantly before Me.
verses.49:17: Your sons hurry; those who demolished you and those who laid you waste will go out from you.
verses.49:18: Raise your eyes all around and see: they all gather together, they come to you. "As I live," declares the LORD, "you will surely wear all of them like an ornament, and you will bind them on like a bride."
verses.49:19: For your waste places and your desolate places and your demolished land—now indeed you will be too cramped for inhabitants, and those who swallowed you up will be far off.
verses.49:20: The children of your bereavement will still say in your ears, "The place is too cramped for me; give me space so that I may dwell."
verses.49:21: And you will say in your heart, "Who has borne these for me? For I was bereaved and barren, exiled and cast aside—and these, who brought them up? Look, I was left by myself; where were these?"
verses.49:22: This is what the Lord GOD says: "See, I will lift My hand to the nations, and to the peoples I will raise My banner; and they will bring your sons in their arms, and your daughters will be carried on their shoulders.
verses.49:23: Kings will become your guardians, and their princesses your nursing mothers. With their faces to the earth they will bow low to you and lick the dust of your feet. And you will know that I am the LORD; those who wait for Me will not be ashamed."
verses.49:24: Can plunder be taken from a mighty warrior, or can the captives of a righteous one be rescued?
verses.49:25: For this is what the LORD says: "Even the captives of a mighty warrior will be taken, and the plunder of a tyrant will be rescued; with the one who contends against you I Myself will contend, and your children I Myself will save.
verses.49:26: And I will cause your oppressors to eat their own flesh, and as with sweet wine they will grow drunk on their own blood; and all flesh will know that I am the LORD your Savior and your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob."
verses.50:1: This is what the LORD says: "Where is your mother's document of divorce with which I sent her away? Or who among My creditors is it to whom I sold you? Look, because of your iniquities you were sold, and because of your transgressions your mother was sent away.
verses.50:2: Why did I come and no one was there? Why did I call and no one answered? Has My hand truly grown too short to ransom, or is there no strength in Me to deliver? See, with My rebuke I dry up the sea; I turn rivers into a wilderness; their fish stink because there is no water, and they die from thirst.
verses.50:3: I clothe the heavens in darkness, and sackcloth I set as their covering."
verses.50:4: The Lord GOD has given me the tongue of disciples, so that I may know how to sustain the weary with a word. He awakens morning by morning; He awakens my ear to hear like disciples.
verses.50:5: The Lord GOD opened my ear, and I did not rebel; I did not draw back.
verses.50:6: My back I gave to those who strike, and my cheeks to those who pluck the beard; my face I did not hide from humiliation and spitting.
verses.50:7: Yet the Lord GOD helps me; for this reason I have not been humiliated; for this reason I have made my face like flint, and I know that I will not be ashamed.
verses.50:8: Near is the One who vindicates me. Who will contend with me? Let us stand together. Who is my adversary at law? Let him approach me.
verses.50:9: Look, the Lord GOD helps me; who is the one who will declare me guilty? See, all of them will wear out like a garment; a moth will devour them.
verses.50:10: Who among you fears the LORD, heeding the voice of His servant? Whoever walks in darkness and has no brightness, let him trust in the name of the LORD and lean upon his God.
verses.50:11: Look, all of you who kindle a fire, who arm yourselves with firebrands: walk in the flame of your fire and among the firebrands you have set burning! From My hand this will happen to you: in anguish you will lie down.
