native_verses.41:11: Look, all who are furious with you will be ashamed and disgraced; the men who contend with you will be like nothing and will perish.
native_verses.41:12: You will search for them and not find them, the men who quarrel with you; the men who wage war against you will be like nothing and like nonexistence.
native_verses.41:13: For I am the LORD your God, who grasps your right hand, who says to you, "Do not be afraid; I Myself will help you."
native_verses.41:14: Do not be afraid, worm of Jacob, men of Israel; I Myself will help you, declares the LORD, and your Redeemer is the Holy One of Israel.
native_verses.41:15: Look, I have made you into a sharp new threshing sledge with many teeth; you will thresh mountains and crush them fine, and the hills you will make like chaff.
native_verses.41:16: You will winnow them, and a wind will lift them away, and a whirlwind will scatter them. Yet you will exult in the LORD; in the Holy One of Israel you will boast.
native_verses.41:17: The afflicted and the needy search for water, and there is none; their tongue is dried up with thirst. I, the LORD, will answer them; I, the God of Israel, will not abandon them.
native_verses.41:18: I will open rivers on bare heights and fountains in the middle of valleys; I will turn the wilderness into a pool of water and parched land into wellsprings of water.
native_verses.41:19: I will place in the wilderness the cedar, the acacia, the myrtle, and the oil tree; I will set in the desert plain the cypress, the elm, and the box tree together,
native_verses.41:20: so that they may see and know, and lay it to heart and perceive together, that the hand of the LORD has done this, and the Holy One of Israel has created it.
native_verses.41:21: "Bring near your case," says the LORD. "Present your strong arguments," says the King of Jacob.
native_verses.41:22: Let them bring them forward and declare to us what will happen. As for the former things, what are they? Declare them, so that we may set our minds on them and know their outcome; or let us hear the things to come.
native_verses.41:23: Declare the things that are coming afterward, so that we may know that you are gods; indeed, do good or do harm, so that we may be alarmed and look on together.
native_verses.41:24: Look, you are less than nothing, and your work is less than nothingness; an abomination is the one who chooses you.
native_verses.41:25: I have roused one from the north, and he has come; from the rising of the sun he will call on My name. He will come upon governors as upon mortar, just as a potter tramples clay.
native_verses.41:26: Who declared this from the beginning, so that we might know, and from earlier times, so that we might say, "He is right"? Indeed, there is no one who declares; indeed, there is no one who proclaims; indeed, there is no one who hears your words.
native_verses.41:27: I first said to Zion, "Look, here they are!" and to Jerusalem I will give one who brings good news.
native_verses.41:28: I look, and there is no one; and among these there is no counselor who, when I question them, can return a reply.
native_verses.41:29: Look, all of them are futility; their deeds are nothing; their cast images are wind and emptiness.
native_verses.42:1: Here is My servant, whom I support, My chosen one, in whom My soul takes pleasure. I have placed My Spirit upon him; he will bring forth justice for the nations.
native_verses.42:2: He will not shout, nor raise his voice, nor cause his voice to be heard in the street.
native_verses.42:3: He will not break a crushed reed, nor extinguish a dim wick; in truth he will bring forth justice.
native_verses.42:4: He will not grow dim nor be crushed until he establishes justice on the earth; and the coastlands wait in hope for his instruction.
native_verses.42:5: This is what God, the LORD, says, the Creator of the heavens who stretches them out, the One who spreads out the earth and what springs from it, who gives breath to the people upon it and spirit to those who walk in it:
native_verses.42:6: "I, the LORD, have summoned you in righteousness; I will take hold of your hand, I will guard you, and I will give you as a covenant for the people, as a light to the nations,
native_verses.42:7: to open blind eyes, to bring a prisoner out of the dungeon, and from the prison house those who dwell in darkness.
native_verses.42:8: I am the LORD; that is My name. My glory I will not give to another, nor My praise to carved images.
native_verses.42:9: Look, the former things have come about, and new things I am declaring; before they sprout forth, I announce them to you."
native_verses.42:10: Sing a new song to the LORD, His praise from the end of the earth, you who go down to the sea and its fullness, you coastlands and their inhabitants.
native_verses.42:11: Let the wilderness and its cities raise their voice, the settlements where Kedar dwells; let the residents of Sela sing for joy; from the top of the mountains let them shout aloud.
native_verses.42:12: Let them ascribe glory to the LORD, and in the coastlands declare His praise.
native_verses.42:13: The LORD will go out like a mighty warrior; like a man of battles He will stir up zeal. He will shout a war cry, indeed He will roar aloud; against His enemies He will prove Himself mighty.
native_verses.42:14: From long ago I have kept silent; I remained quiet and restrained Myself. Like a woman giving birth I will cry out; I will gasp and pant together.
native_verses.42:15: I will make mountains and hills desolate, and all their vegetation I will dry up; I will turn rivers into islands, and pools I will dry up.
native_verses.42:16: And I will lead the blind along a road they have not known; on paths they have not known I will guide them. I will make the darkness before them into light, and crooked places into level ground. These are the things: I will do them, and I will not abandon them.
native_verses.42:17: They are turned back, they will be put to utter shame, those who trust in a carved image, who say to a cast image, "You are our gods."
native_verses.42:18: You deaf ones, hear! And you blind ones, look so that you may see!
native_verses.42:19: Who is blind except My servant, or deaf like My messenger whom I send? Who is blind like the one at peace, or blind like the servant of the LORD?
native_verses.42:20: Seeing many things, yet you do not observe them; opening the ears, yet he does not hear.
native_verses.42:21: The LORD was pleased, for the sake of His righteousness, to make instruction great and glorious.
native_verses.42:22: Yet it is a people plundered and despoiled; all of them are ensnared in holes, and in prison houses they have been hidden away. They have become plunder with no one to deliver, and spoil with no one saying, "Give it back!"
native_verses.42:23: Which of you will give ear to this, pay attention and hear for the time to come?
native_verses.42:24: Who gave Jacob over as spoil, and Israel to plunderers? Was it not the LORD, the One against whom we have sinned, in whose ways they were unwilling to walk, and to whose instruction they did not listen?
native_verses.42:25: So He poured out upon him the fury of His anger and the might of war; it set him ablaze on every side, yet he did not realize it; it burned him, yet he would not lay it to heart.
native_verses.43:1: But now, this is what the LORD says—He who created you, Jacob, and He who formed you, Israel: "Do not be afraid, for I have redeemed you; I have called you by your name; you belong to Me.
native_verses.43:2: When you cross through the waters, I am with you, and through the rivers, they will not flood over you; when you walk through fire, you will not be scorched, and flame will not burn against you.
native_verses.43:3: For I am the LORD your God, the Holy One of Israel, your Savior. I have given Egypt as a ransom for you, Cush and Seba instead of you.
native_verses.43:4: Because you are precious in My eyes, you are honored, and I love you, I will give people instead of you and nations in place of your life.
native_verses.43:5: Do not be afraid, for I am with you; from the east I will bring your seed, and from the west I will gather you.
native_verses.43:6: I will say to the north, 'Give them up,' and to the south, 'Do not hold back! Bring My sons from afar and My daughters from the end of the earth,
native_verses.43:7: everyone who is called by My name, whom I created for My glory, whom I formed—indeed, whom I made.'"
native_verses.43:8: "Bring out the people who are blind, though they have eyes, and the deaf, though they have ears.
native_verses.43:9: Let all the nations gather together, and let the peoples assemble. Who among them can declare this and announce the former things to us? Let them present their witnesses that they may be proved right, and let them hear and say, 'It is true.'
native_verses.43:10: You are My witnesses," declares the LORD, "and My servant whom I chose, in order that you may know, trust Me, and discern that I am He. Before Me no god was formed, and after Me none will exist.
native_verses.43:11: I—I am the LORD, and there is no savior apart from Me.
native_verses.43:12: I Myself declared, saved, and proclaimed, when there was no foreign god in your midst; so you are My witnesses," declares the LORD, "and I am God.
native_verses.43:13: Even from the first day I am He, and no one can rescue from My hand; I act, and who can turn it back?"
native_verses.43:14: This is what the LORD, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel, says: "For your sake I have sent to Babylon, and I will bring all of them down as fugitives, even the Chaldeans, in the ships of their jubilation.
native_verses.43:15: I am the LORD, your Holy One, the Creator of Israel, your King."
native_verses.43:16: This is what the LORD says, who sets a way in the sea and a path in mighty waters,
native_verses.43:17: who leads out chariot and horse, army and mighty force—they lie down together, they will not rise; they are snuffed out, quenched like a wick:
native_verses.43:18: "Do not recall the former things, and do not reflect upon the things of long ago.
native_verses.43:19: Look, I am doing something new; now it sprouts forth—do you not recognize it? Indeed, I will set a way in the wilderness and rivers in the wasteland.
native_verses.43:20: The wild beasts of the field will honor Me, the jackals and the ostriches, because I have given water in the wilderness and rivers in the wasteland, to give drink to My people, My chosen one,
native_verses.43:21: the people whom I formed for Myself; they will recount My praise.
native_verses.43:22: Yet you did not call upon Me, Jacob; instead, you have grown weary of Me, Israel.
native_verses.43:23: You have not brought Me the sheep of your burnt offerings, nor have you honored Me with your sacrifices; I have not burdened you with a grain offering, nor have I wearied you with frankincense.
native_verses.43:24: You have not bought Me sweet cane with silver, nor have you satisfied Me with the fat of your sacrifices. Instead, you have burdened Me with your sins; you have wearied Me with your iniquities.
native_verses.43:25: I—I am He who wipes out your transgressions for My own sake, and your sins I will not remember.
native_verses.43:26: Remind Me; let us contend in judgment together. Recount your case yourself, so that you may be vindicated.
native_verses.43:27: Your first father sinned, and your mediators rebelled against Me.
native_verses.43:28: Therefore I will profane the officials of the sanctuary, and I will give Jacob to utter destruction and Israel to reviling."
native_verses.44:1: "But now listen, Jacob My servant, and Israel, whom I have chosen."
native_verses.44:2: This is what the LORD says, who made you and formed you from the womb, who will help you: "Do not be afraid, My servant Jacob, and Jeshurun, whom I have chosen.
native_verses.44:3: For I will pour out water upon thirsty ground and flowing streams upon the dry land; I will pour out My Spirit upon your seed and My blessing upon your descendants.
native_verses.44:4: They will sprout among the grass, like willows along channels of water.
native_verses.44:5: One will say, 'I belong to the LORD,' and another will call himself by the name of Jacob; still another will write on his hand, 'Belonging to the LORD,' and title himself by the name of Israel."
native_verses.44:6: This is what the LORD, the King of Israel and his Redeemer, the LORD of hosts, says: "I am first and I am last, and apart from Me there is no God.
native_verses.44:7: Who is like Me? Let him proclaim it, declare it, and set it in order before Me, from the time I established an ancient people; and let them declare to them the things to come and what will arrive.
native_verses.44:8: Do not tremble and do not be terrified. Have I not announced to you from long ago and declared it? You are My witnesses! Is there a God apart from Me? There is no Rock; I know of none."
native_verses.44:9: All who form an idol are emptiness, and their prized things cannot profit; and their witnesses themselves neither see nor know, so that they will be put to shame.
native_verses.44:10: Who has formed a god or cast an idol that is of no profit?
native_verses.44:11: Look, all his companions will be put to shame, for the craftsmen are merely human. Let them all assemble and take their stand; they will tremble and be put to shame together.
native_verses.44:12: The ironsmith works a cutting tool over the coals; he forms it with hammers and works it with his strong arm. Yet he becomes hungry and has no strength; he drinks no water and grows faint.
native_verses.44:13: The woodworker stretches out a line; he outlines it with a stylus, shapes it with planes, and outlines it with a compass. He makes it in the form of a man, with the beauty of a human being, to dwell in a house.
native_verses.44:14: He cuts down cedars for himself, and takes a cypress and an oak, and lets it grow strong for himself among the trees of the forest. He plants a pine, and the rain makes it grow.
native_verses.44:15: Then it becomes something for a man to burn; he takes some of it and warms himself. He also kindles a fire and bakes bread; he also fashions a god and bows down to it—he makes it an idol and falls prostrate before it.
native_verses.44:16: Half of it he burns in the fire; over half of it he eats meat—he roasts a roast and is satisfied. He also warms himself and says, "Aha, I am warm! I have seen the fire!"
native_verses.44:17: The rest of it he makes into a god, his idol; he falls prostrate before it and bows down, and he prays to it and says, "Rescue me, for you are my god!"
native_verses.44:18: They do not know and they do not understand, for their eyes have been plastered shut from seeing, and their hearts from comprehending.
native_verses.44:19: He does not take it to heart, nor is there knowledge or discernment to say, "Half of it I burned in the fire; I also baked bread over its coals, roasted meat, and ate it. Shall I make the rest of it into an abomination? Shall I fall prostrate before a block of wood?"
native_verses.44:20: He feeds on ashes; a deluded heart has led him astray, so that he cannot rescue his own life, nor say, "Is there not a lie in my right hand?"
native_verses.44:21: "Remember these things, Jacob, and Israel, because you are My servant; I formed you, you are a servant to Me—Israel, you will not be forgotten by Me.
native_verses.44:22: Like a thick cloud I have wiped out your transgressions, and like a cloud your sins; turn back to Me, for I have redeemed you."
native_verses.44:23: Sing for joy, heavens, for the LORD has acted! Shout aloud, depths of the earth! Break forth into joyful song, mountains, forest, and every tree in it! For the LORD has redeemed Jacob, and in Israel He will glorify Himself.
native_verses.44:24: This is what the LORD, your Redeemer and He who formed you from the womb, says: "I am the LORD, who makes all things, who stretches out the heavens alone, who spreads out the earth by Myself;
native_verses.44:25: who nullifies the signs of liars and turns diviners into fools, who sends the wise backward and renders their knowledge foolish;
native_verses.44:26: who confirms the word of His servant and fulfills the counsel of His messengers; who says of Jerusalem, 'She will be inhabited,' and of the cities of Judah, 'They will be built,' and I will raise up her ruins;
native_verses.44:27: who says to the deep, 'Be dry, and I will dry up your rivers';
native_verses.44:28: who says of Cyrus, 'He is My shepherd, and he will fulfill all My desire,' and saying of Jerusalem, 'She will be built,' and of the temple, 'Its foundation will be laid.'"
native_verses.45:1: This is what the LORD says to His anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have taken hold of to subdue nations before him, and I will unfasten the loins of kings, to open double doors before him, and gates will not be shut:
native_verses.45:2: "I Myself will go before you and make the rugged terrain level; doors of bronze I will shatter, and bars of iron I will hew through.
native_verses.45:3: And I will give you treasures of darkness and hidden stores of secret places, so that you may know that I am the LORD, who calls you by your name, the God of Israel.
native_verses.45:4: For the sake of My servant Jacob, and Israel My chosen one, I called you by your name; I designate you by an honored title, even though you do not know Me.
native_verses.45:5: I am the LORD, and there is no other; apart from Me there is no God. I gird you, even though you do not know Me,
native_verses.45:6: so that they may know from the rising of the sun and from the west that there is none apart from Me; I am the LORD, and there is no other,
native_verses.45:7: forming light and creating darkness, making peace and creating disaster; I, the LORD, am the One who does all of these.
native_verses.45:8: Shower down, heavens, from above, and let the skies pour out righteousness; let the earth open up so that they bear salvation as fruit, and let it cause righteousness to sprout together; I, the LORD, have created it."
native_verses.45:9: Woe to the one who quarrels with his Maker—a potsherd among the potsherds of the ground! Will clay say to the one who forms it, "What are you making?" or, "Your work has no hands"?
native_verses.45:10: Woe to the one who says to a father, "What are you fathering?" or to a woman, "With what are you in labor?"
native_verses.45:11: This is what the LORD, the Holy One of Israel and his Maker, says: "Ask Me about the things to come; concerning My sons and concerning the work of My hands, will you command Me?
native_verses.45:12: It is I who made the earth, and I created mankind upon it; My own hands stretched out the heavens, and all their host I commanded.
native_verses.45:13: It is I who stirred him up in righteousness, and all his ways I will make level; he will build My city and release My exiles, not for a price and not for a bribe," says the LORD of hosts.
native_verses.45:14: This is what the LORD says: "The earnings of Egypt and the trade of Cush, and the Sabeans, men of stature, will pass over to you and will be yours; behind you they will walk, in chains they will pass over, and to you they will bow down; to you they will plead, 'Surely God is in you, and there is no other; there is no god besides.'"
native_verses.45:15: Indeed, You are a God who hides Himself, God of Israel, Savior.
native_verses.45:16: They have been put to shame and also humiliated, all of them; together they have gone off in humiliation, the craftsmen of idols.
native_verses.45:17: Israel has been saved by the LORD with an everlasting salvation; you will not be put to shame and you will not be humiliated for all eternity.
native_verses.45:18: For this is what the LORD says, Creator of the heavens—He is God—who formed the earth and made it; He established it; He did not create it a wasteland, He formed it to be inhabited: "I am the LORD, and there is no other.
native_verses.45:19: I have not spoken in secret, in a place of a land of darkness; I did not say to the seed of Jacob, 'Seek Me in vain.' I, the LORD, speak righteousness, declaring things that are upright.
native_verses.45:20: Gather yourselves and come, draw near together, survivors of the nations! They have no knowledge, those who carry the wood of their carved image and pray to a god that does not save.
native_verses.45:21: Declare and bring it forward; indeed, let them take counsel together! Who proclaimed this from ancient times, declared it from long ago? Was it not I, the LORD? And there is no other God besides Me, a righteous God and a Savior; there is none apart from Me.
native_verses.45:22: Turn toward Me and be saved, all the farthest bounds of the earth, because I am God, and there is no other.
native_verses.45:23: By Myself I have sworn; a word has gone out from My mouth in righteousness and it will not turn back: that to Me every knee will bend, every tongue will swear.
native_verses.45:24: 'Only in the LORD,' one will say of Me, 'are righteousness and strength.'" To Him they will come and be put to shame, all who are incensed against Him.
native_verses.45:25: In the LORD all the seed of Israel will be vindicated and will glory.
native_verses.46:1: Bel has bent down, Nebo stoops; their idols are put on beasts and on livestock; what you carry is loaded up, a burden for the weary animal.
native_verses.46:2: They stooped, they bent down together; they were unable to rescue the burden, and they themselves have gone off into captivity.
native_verses.46:3: Listen to Me, house of Jacob, and all the remnant of the house of Israel, who have been borne from birth, who have been carried from the womb:
native_verses.46:4: And until old age I am He, and until gray hair I Myself will bear you; I made you, and I will carry you; I Myself will bear you and rescue you.
native_verses.46:5: To whom will you liken Me and make Me equal, and compare Me, so that we should be alike?
native_verses.46:6: Those who pour out gold from a bag and weigh out silver on the scale hire a metalworker, and he makes it into a god; they fall down, yes, they bow in worship.
native_verses.46:7: They lift it onto a shoulder, they bear it, and they set it down in its place, and it stands there; from its place it does not move. Even if one cries out to it, it does not answer; from his distress it does not save him.
native_verses.46:8: Remember this and be resolute; bring it back to heart, you rebels.
native_verses.46:9: Remember the former things from long ago, because I am God, and there is no other—God, and there is none like Me,
native_verses.46:10: declaring the outcome from the beginning, and from earliest times things that have not been done, saying, "My counsel will stand, and all My delight I will carry out,"
native_verses.46:11: calling a bird of prey from the east, from a distant land the man of My counsel. Indeed I have spoken, indeed I will bring it about; I have formed it, indeed I will do it.
native_verses.46:12: Listen to Me, you stubborn of heart, who are far from righteousness:
native_verses.46:13: I have brought My righteousness near; it will not be far off, and My salvation will not delay. And I will grant salvation in Zion, for Israel My splendor.
native_verses.47:1: Come down and sit on the dust, virgin daughter of Babylon; sit on the ground without a throne, daughter of the Chaldeans! For no longer will they call you "Tender and Pampered."
native_verses.47:2: Take millstones and grind flour; uncover your veil, strip off the skirt, uncover the leg, cross over rivers.
native_verses.47:3: Your nakedness will be uncovered, and your disgrace will also be seen; I will take vengeance, and I will spare no human.
native_verses.47:4: Our Redeemer—the LORD of hosts is His name—is the Holy One of Israel.
native_verses.47:5: Sit in silence and go into the darkness, daughter of the Chaldeans! For no longer will they call you "Mistress of Kingdoms."
native_verses.47:6: I was angry with My people; I profaned My inheritance and gave them into your hand. You showed them no compassion; on the aged you made your yoke exceedingly heavy.
native_verses.47:7: And you said, "Forever I will be a mistress," so that you did not lay these things to your heart; you did not remember its outcome.
native_verses.47:8: And now, listen to this, you lover of luxury, who sits securely, who says in her heart, "I am, and there is no one besides me; I will not sit as a widow, and I will not know the loss of children."
native_verses.47:9: Both of these things will come to you in a moment, in a single day: loss of children and widowhood. In full measure they will come upon you, in spite of your many sorceries, in spite of the exceeding power of your spells.
native_verses.47:10: You trusted in your wickedness; you said, "No one sees me." Your wisdom and your knowledge—it is they that led you astray; and you said in your heart, "I am, and there is no one besides me."
native_verses.47:11: So disaster will come upon you that you will not know how to charm away; and ruin will fall upon you that you will not be able to buy off; and devastation will come upon you suddenly that you do not know.
native_verses.47:12: Stand fast now with your spells and with your many sorceries, in which you have labored from your youth; perhaps you will be able to profit, perhaps you will strike terror.
native_verses.47:13: You have grown weary with your many counsels; let them stand up now and save you—those who divide the heavens, who gaze at the stars, who make known at the new moons what will come upon you.
native_verses.47:14: Look, they have become like stubble; fire has burned them up. They cannot deliver themselves from the grip of the flame; it is no coal for warming oneself, no fire to sit before!
native_verses.47:15: Such have they become to you with whom you have labored, your traders from your youth: each one has wandered off in his own direction; there is no one to save you.
native_verses.48:1: Hear this, house of Jacob, who are called by the name of Israel and came forth from the waters of Judah, who swear by the name of the LORD and make mention of the God of Israel, not in truth and not in righteousness.
native_verses.48:2: For they are called after the holy city and rely on the God of Israel; the LORD of hosts is His name.
native_verses.48:3: The former things I declared from long ago; out of My mouth they went forth, and I made them heard. Suddenly I acted, and they came about.
native_verses.48:4: Because I knew that you are stubborn, and your neck is a sinew of iron and your forehead is bronze,
native_verses.48:5: I declared it to you from long ago; before it came about I made you hear it, so that you would not say, "My idol made them, and my carved image and my cast image commanded them."
native_verses.48:6: You have heard; see all of it. And as for you, will you not declare it? From now on I cause you to hear new things, secret things that you have not known.
native_verses.48:7: Now they are created, and not from long ago; and before today you did not hear them, so that you would not say, "Look, I knew them."
native_verses.48:8: You have neither heard nor known, nor from long ago has your ear opened; for I knew that you would indeed act treacherously, and you were called a transgressor from the womb.
native_verses.48:9: For My name's sake I delay My anger, and for My praise I curb it for you, so as not to cut you off.
native_verses.48:10: Look, I have refined you, though not as silver; I have tested you in the smelting furnace of affliction.
native_verses.48:11: For My own sake, for My own sake, I will act; for how could it be profaned? And I will not give My glory to another.
native_verses.48:12: Listen to Me, Jacob, and Israel, My called one: I am He; I am the first, and also I am the last.
native_verses.48:13: Indeed, My hand laid the foundation of the earth, and My right hand spread out the heavens; I call to them, and they stand up together.
native_verses.48:14: Gather together, all of you, and listen! Who among them has declared these things? The LORD loves him; he will do His pleasure on Babylon, and His arm will be against the Chaldeans.
native_verses.48:15: I, I Myself have spoken; yes, I have called him. I have brought him, and his way will succeed.
native_verses.48:16: Come close to Me, hear this: from the start I did not speak in secret; from the time it came to be, there I was. And now the Lord GOD has sent me, and His Spirit.
native_verses.48:17: This is what the LORD, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel, says: "I am the LORD your God, who teaches you for your benefit, who guides you in the way you should walk.
native_verses.48:18: If only you had given heed to My commandments, then your peace would have been like a river and your righteousness like the waves of the sea;
native_verses.48:19: and your seed would have been like the sand, and the descendants from your body like its grains; its name would not be cut off or destroyed from before Me."
native_verses.48:20: Go out from Babylon, flee from the Chaldeans! With a voice of joyful shouting declare it, make this heard, send it forth to the end of the earth; say, "The LORD has redeemed His servant Jacob."
native_verses.48:21: They did not become thirsty when He led them through the waste places; He caused water to stream from the rock for them; He split open the rock, and water gushed out.
native_verses.48:22: "There is no peace," the LORD says, "for the wicked."
native_verses.49:1: Hear me, coastlands, and give heed, peoples from afar: the LORD called me from the womb; from my mother's body He made mention of my name.
native_verses.49:2: He has made my mouth like a sharp sword; in the shadow of His hand He hid me. He set me as a polished arrow; in His quiver He concealed me.
native_verses.49:3: And He said to me, "You are My servant, Israel, in whom I will display My splendor."
native_verses.49:4: But I said, "For nothing I have toiled; for emptiness and vapor I have used up my strength. Yet certainly my justice is with the LORD, and my reward is with my God."
native_verses.49:5: And now the LORD says, the One who formed me from the womb to be a servant to Him, to bring Jacob back to Him and for Israel to be gathered to Him—and I am honored in the eyes of the LORD, and my God has become my strength—
native_verses.49:6: He says, "It is too light a matter for you to be My servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob and to bring back the preserved ones of Israel; I will also give you as a light to the nations, to be My salvation to the end of the earth."
native_verses.49:7: This is what the LORD, the Redeemer of Israel and its Holy One, says to one despised in soul, to one loathed by a nation, to a servant of rulers: "Kings will see and rise up, princes also will bow low, for the sake of the LORD, who is faithful, the Holy One of Israel, and He has chosen you."
native_verses.49:8: This is what the LORD says: "In a time of favor I answered you, and on a day of salvation I helped you; I will preserve you and give you as a covenant for the people, to raise up the land, to allot the desolate inheritances,
native_verses.49:9: saying to the prisoners, 'Go out,' and to those in darkness, 'Reveal yourselves.' Along the roads they will graze, and on all bare heights will be their pasture.
native_verses.49:10: They will not be hungry and will not be thirsty, nor will scorching heat or sun strike them; for the One who has compassion on them will lead them, and beside springs of water He will guide them.
native_verses.49:11: And I will make all My mountains into a road, and My highways will be lifted high.
native_verses.49:12: Look, these will come from afar; and see, these from the north and from the west, and these from the land of Sinim."
native_verses.49:13: Ring out with joy, heavens, and exult, earth, and burst forth, mountains, into a joyful shout! For the LORD has comforted His people and will show compassion to His afflicted ones.
native_verses.49:14: Yet Zion said, "The LORD has abandoned me, and the Lord has forgotten me."
native_verses.49:15: Can a woman forget her nursing infant, without having compassion on the son of her womb? Even these may forget, yet I Myself will not forget you.
native_verses.49:16: See, on My palms I have engraved you; your walls are constantly before Me.
native_verses.49:17: Your sons hurry; those who demolished you and those who laid you waste will go out from you.
native_verses.49:18: Raise your eyes all around and see: they all gather together, they come to you. "As I live," declares the LORD, "you will surely wear all of them like an ornament, and you will bind them on like a bride."
native_verses.49:19: For your waste places and your desolate places and your demolished land—now indeed you will be too cramped for inhabitants, and those who swallowed you up will be far off.
native_verses.49:20: The children of your bereavement will still say in your ears, "The place is too cramped for me; give me space so that I may dwell."
native_verses.49:21: And you will say in your heart, "Who has borne these for me? For I was bereaved and barren, exiled and cast aside—and these, who brought them up? Look, I was left by myself; where were these?"
native_verses.49:22: This is what the Lord GOD says: "See, I will lift My hand to the nations, and to the peoples I will raise My banner; and they will bring your sons in their arms, and your daughters will be carried on their shoulders.
native_verses.49:23: Kings will become your guardians, and their princesses your nursing mothers. With their faces to the earth they will bow low to you and lick the dust of your feet. And you will know that I am the LORD; those who wait for Me will not be ashamed."
native_verses.49:24: Can plunder be taken from a mighty warrior, or can the captives of a righteous one be rescued?
native_verses.49:25: For this is what the LORD says: "Even the captives of a mighty warrior will be taken, and the plunder of a tyrant will be rescued; with the one who contends against you I Myself will contend, and your children I Myself will save.
native_verses.49:26: And I will cause your oppressors to eat their own flesh, and as with sweet wine they will grow drunk on their own blood; and all flesh will know that I am the LORD your Savior and your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob."
native_verses.50:1: This is what the LORD says: "Where is your mother's document of divorce with which I sent her away? Or who among My creditors is it to whom I sold you? Look, because of your iniquities you were sold, and because of your transgressions your mother was sent away.
native_verses.50:2: Why did I come and no one was there? Why did I call and no one answered? Has My hand truly grown too short to ransom, or is there no strength in Me to deliver? See, with My rebuke I dry up the sea; I turn rivers into a wilderness; their fish stink because there is no water, and they die from thirst.
native_verses.50:3: I clothe the heavens in darkness, and sackcloth I set as their covering."
native_verses.50:4: The Lord GOD has given me the tongue of disciples, so that I may know how to sustain the weary with a word. He awakens morning by morning; He awakens my ear to hear like disciples.
native_verses.50:5: The Lord GOD opened my ear, and I did not rebel; I did not draw back.
native_verses.50:6: My back I gave to those who strike, and my cheeks to those who pluck the beard; my face I did not hide from humiliation and spitting.
native_verses.50:7: Yet the Lord GOD helps me; for this reason I have not been humiliated; for this reason I have made my face like flint, and I know that I will not be ashamed.
native_verses.50:8: Near is the One who vindicates me. Who will contend with me? Let us stand together. Who is my adversary at law? Let him approach me.
native_verses.50:9: Look, the Lord GOD helps me; who is the one who will declare me guilty? See, all of them will wear out like a garment; a moth will devour them.
native_verses.50:10: Who among you fears the LORD, heeding the voice of His servant? Whoever walks in darkness and has no brightness, let him trust in the name of the LORD and lean upon his God.
native_verses.50:11: Look, all of you who kindle a fire, who arm yourselves with firebrands: walk in the flame of your fire and among the firebrands you have set burning! From My hand this will happen to you: in anguish you will lie down.
native_verses.51:1: Listen to Me, you who pursue righteousness, who seek the LORD; look to the rock from which you were carved out, and to the hollow of the pit from which you were dug out.
native_verses.51:2: Look to Abraham your father, and to Sarah who gave birth to you; for while he was just one I called him, and I blessed him and multiplied him.
native_verses.51:3: For the LORD has comforted Zion; He has comforted all her ruins, and He has made her wilderness like Eden and her desert plain like the garden of the LORD; joy and gladness will be found in her, thanksgiving and the sound of song.
native_verses.51:4: Attend to Me, My people, and give ear to Me, My nation; for instruction will go out from Me, and I will establish My justice as a light to the peoples.
native_verses.51:5: Near is My righteousness; My salvation has gone out, and My arms will judge the peoples; for Me the coastlands will wait, and for My arm they will hope.
native_verses.51:6: Lift up your eyes to the heavens, and look at the earth below; for the heavens will dissipate like smoke, and the earth will wear out like a garment, and its inhabitants will die in the same way. But My salvation will be forever, and My righteousness will not be shattered.
native_verses.51:7: Listen to Me, you who know righteousness, a people with My instruction in their heart: do not be afraid of the reproach of mortal man, and do not be dismayed at their insults.
native_verses.51:8: For the moth will eat them like a garment, and the grub will eat them like wool; but My righteousness will be forever, and My salvation through generation after generation.
native_verses.51:9: Awake, awake, put on strength, arm of the LORD! Awake as in ancient days, the generations of ages past! Are You not the One who hacked Rahab apart, who pierced the sea monster?
native_verses.51:10: Are You not the One who dried up the sea, the waters of the great deep, who made the depths of the sea a road for the redeemed to cross over?
native_verses.51:11: And the ransomed of the LORD will return and come to Zion with ringing song, with everlasting gladness on their heads; they will attain joy and gladness; grief and sighing will flee.
native_verses.51:12: I, I Myself am He who comforts you. Who are you that you should fear mortal man who will die, and a son of man who will be made like grass,
native_verses.51:13: and have forgotten the LORD, your Maker, who stretches out the heavens and lays the foundation of the earth, and dread continually all day long before the fury of the oppressor when he makes ready to destroy? And where is the fury of the oppressor?
native_verses.51:14: The one bowed down will swiftly be loosed; he will not die in the pit, and his bread will not fail.
native_verses.51:15: And I am the LORD your God, who stirs the sea so that its waves roar—the LORD of hosts is His name.
native_verses.51:16: And I have placed My words in your mouth and covered you in the shadow of My hand, to plant the heavens and lay the foundation of the earth, and to say to Zion, "You are My people."
native_verses.51:17: Rouse yourself, rouse yourself! Arise, Jerusalem, you who have drunk from the hand of the LORD the cup of His fury; the goblet of the cup of staggering you have drunk, you have drained it dry.
native_verses.51:18: There is no one to guide her from all the sons she has borne, and no one holding her by the hand from all the sons she has raised.
native_verses.51:19: These two things have come upon you—who will grieve over you?—devastation and ruin, and famine and sword; how can I comfort you?
native_verses.51:20: Your sons have fainted; they lie at the head of all the streets like an antelope in a net, full of the fury of the LORD, the rebuke of your God.
native_verses.51:21: Therefore, hear this now, afflicted one, you who are drunk, yet not from wine:
native_verses.51:22: This is what your Lord, the LORD, and your God who pleads the case of His people says: "Look, I have taken from your hand the cup of staggering; the goblet of the cup of My fury you will never drink again.
native_verses.51:23: And I will place it in the hand of your tormentors, who said to your soul, 'Bow down so that we may pass over,' and you set your back like the ground, and like the street for those passing over."
native_verses.52:1: Awake, awake, put on your strength, Zion! Put on your garments of splendor, Jerusalem, the holy city; for never again will the uncircumcised and the unclean enter into you.
native_verses.52:2: Shake yourself from the dust; arise, take your seat, Jerusalem; loose from yourself the bonds of your neck, captive daughter of Zion.
native_verses.52:3: For this is what the LORD says: "For nothing you were sold, and not with money will you be redeemed."
native_verses.52:4: For this is what the Lord GOD says: "To Egypt My people went down at first to sojourn there, and Assyria oppressed them without cause.
native_verses.52:5: And now, what do I have here," declares the LORD, "since My people have been taken away for nothing? Those who rule over them howl," declares the LORD, "and continually all day long My name is treated with contempt.
native_verses.52:6: Therefore My people will know My name; therefore on that day they will know that I am He who speaks—here I am!"
native_verses.52:7: How lovely upon the mountains are the feet of a herald of good news, who proclaims peace, who heralds what is good, who proclaims salvation, who says to Zion, "Your God reigns!"
native_verses.52:8: The voice of your watchmen! They raise their voice; together they shout for joy, for eye to eye they will see when the LORD returns to Zion.
native_verses.52:9: Burst out, shout for joy together, ruins of Jerusalem! For the LORD has comforted His people; He has redeemed Jerusalem.
native_verses.52:10: The LORD has laid bare His holy arm before the eyes of all the nations, and all the ends of the earth will see the salvation of our God.
native_verses.52:11: Depart, depart, come out from there! Do not touch anything unclean; come out from her midst, make yourselves pure, you who carry the vessels of the LORD.
native_verses.52:12: For not in haste will you go out, and not in flight will you go; for the LORD is going before you, and your rear guard is the God of Israel.
native_verses.52:13: Look, My servant will act wisely; he will be exalted and lifted up, and will be exceedingly high.
native_verses.52:14: Just as many were appalled at you—so disfigured was his appearance beyond that of a man, and his form beyond the sons of men—
native_verses.52:15: so he will sprinkle many nations; kings will close their mouths because of him, for what had not been recounted to them they will see, and what they had not heard they will comprehend.
native_verses.53:1: Who has believed what we have heard? And the arm of the LORD, to whom has it been revealed?
native_verses.53:2: He grew up before Him like a young shoot, and like a root out of parched ground. He had no form and no splendor; and when we looked at him, there was no appearance that we should find him desirable.
native_verses.53:3: He was despised and abandoned by people, a man of pains and familiar with sickness; and like one from whom faces are hidden, he was despised, and we did not value him.
native_verses.53:4: Yet surely it was our sicknesses that he bore, and our pains that he carried; but we ourselves regarded him as stricken, struck down by God, and afflicted.
native_verses.53:5: But he was pierced because of our transgressions, crushed because of our iniquities; the discipline for our peace was on him, and by his welts healing has come to us.
native_verses.53:6: All of us have strayed like sheep; we have turned, each one, to his own way; and the LORD has made the iniquity of us all land on him.
native_verses.53:7: He was oppressed, and he was afflicted, yet he would not open his mouth; like a lamb that is led to the slaughter, and like a ewe that is silent before her shearers, he would not open his mouth.
native_verses.53:8: By restraint and judgment he was taken away; and as for his generation, who considered it? For he was cut off from the land of the living; because of the transgression of my people the blow fell on him.
native_verses.53:9: And they assigned his grave with the wicked, and with a rich man in his deaths, although he had done no violence, and there was no deceit in his mouth.
native_verses.53:10: Yet the LORD was pleased to crush him; He made him sick. If his soul makes a guilt offering, he will see seed, he will lengthen his days, and the pleasure of the LORD will succeed in his hand.
native_verses.53:11: Because of the anguish of his soul he will see, he will be satisfied; by his knowledge the righteous one, My servant, will make the many righteous, and he himself will carry their iniquities.
native_verses.53:12: Therefore I will give him a portion among the many, and with the mighty he will divide the spoil, because he laid bare his soul to death and was counted with the transgressors; yet he himself bore the sin of many, and for the transgressors he will intercede.
native_verses.54:1: "Ring out in joy, barren woman who has not given birth; burst into joyful song and cry aloud, you who have not been in labor! For more numerous are the children of the desolate woman than the children of the married woman," says the LORD.
native_verses.54:2: "Widen the space of your tent, and let them stretch out the curtains of your dwellings; do not hold back! Lengthen your cords, and strengthen your pegs.
native_verses.54:3: For to the right and to the left you will spread out, and your seed will possess nations and populate desolate cities.
native_verses.54:4: Do not be afraid, for you will not be ashamed; and do not be humiliated, for you will not be disgraced; for you will forget the shame of your youth, and you will no longer remember the reproach of your widowhood.
native_verses.54:5: For your husband is your Maker—the LORD of hosts is His name—and your Redeemer is the Holy One of Israel; the God of all the earth He will be called.
native_verses.54:6: For as a wife abandoned and sorrowful in spirit the LORD has called you, and as a wife of youth when she is rejected," says your God.
native_verses.54:7: "For a short moment I abandoned you, yet with great compassion I will gather you.
native_verses.54:8: In a surge of anger I hid My face from you for a moment, but with everlasting loyal love I will have compassion on you," says your Redeemer, the LORD.
native_verses.54:9: "For this is to Me like the waters of Noah: just as I swore that the waters of Noah would not pass over the earth again, so I have sworn not to be angry with you and not to rebuke you.
native_verses.54:10: For though the mountains move away and the hills totter, My loyal love will not move away from you, and the covenant of My peace will not totter," says the LORD, who shows you compassion.
native_verses.54:11: "Afflicted one, tossed by storms, not comforted: look, I am setting your stones in antimony, and I will lay your foundation with sapphires.
native_verses.54:12: And I will make your pinnacles of rubies, your gates of sparkling stones, and all your border of precious stones.
native_verses.54:13: And all your children will be disciples of the LORD, and abundant will be the peace of your children.
native_verses.54:14: By righteousness you will be established; be far from oppression, for you will not be afraid, and from terror, for it will not approach you.
native_verses.54:15: Look, if anyone indeed attacks, it is not from Me; whoever attacks you will fall because of you.
native_verses.54:16: See, I have created the smith who blows on the fire of charcoal and brings out a weapon for its task, and I have created the destroyer to ravage.
native_verses.54:17: No weapon crafted against you will succeed, and every tongue that rises against you in judgment you will convict. This is the inheritance of the servants of the LORD, and their righteousness is from Me," declares the LORD.
native_verses.55:1: Come, every thirsty one, come to the waters, and whoever has no silver, come, purchase and eat; and come, purchase wine and milk without silver and without payment.
native_verses.55:2: Why do you weigh out silver for what is not bread, and your labor for what brings no satisfaction? Listen intently to Me, and eat what is good, and let your soul delight itself in rich fare.
native_verses.55:3: Turn your ear and come to Me; listen, and your soul will live; and I will make an eternal covenant for you, the sure acts of loyal love to David.
native_verses.55:4: Look, I have appointed him as a witness to peoples, a ruler and commander of peoples.
native_verses.55:5: Look, you will summon a nation you do not know, and a nation that has not known you will run to you, for the sake of the LORD your God, and for the Holy One of Israel, because He has glorified you.
native_verses.55:6: Seek the LORD while He can be found; call out to Him while He is near.
native_verses.55:7: Let the wicked abandon his way, and the man of iniquity his thoughts; and let him return to the LORD, that He may show him compassion, and to our God, for He will forgive abundantly.
native_verses.55:8: For My thoughts are not your thoughts, and your ways are not My ways, declares the LORD.
native_verses.55:9: For just as the heavens are higher than the earth, so My ways stand higher than your ways, and My thoughts than your thoughts.
native_verses.55:10: For just as the rain and the snow descend from the heavens and do not return there, but instead saturate the earth, causing it to bring forth and sprout, and giving seed to the one who sows and bread to the one who eats,
native_verses.55:11: so My word will be that goes out from My mouth: it will not return to Me empty, but instead it will carry out what I delight in, and it will succeed in that for which I sent it.
native_verses.55:12: For with joy you will go out, and in peace you will be led along; the mountains and the hills will burst into joyful shouting before you, and all the trees of the field will clap their hands.
native_verses.55:13: Instead of the thornbush a cypress will grow up, and instead of the brier a myrtle will grow up; and it will become a name for the LORD, an eternal sign that will not be cut off.
native_verses.56:1: This is what the LORD says: "Keep justice and practice righteousness, for My salvation is near to come, and My righteousness to be revealed."
native_verses.56:2: Blessed is the mortal who does this, and the son of man who holds fast to it, who keeps the Sabbath without profaning it, and who keeps his hand from doing anything evil.
native_verses.56:3: And do not let the foreigner who has joined himself to the LORD say, "The LORD will certainly separate me from His people," and do not let the eunuch say, "Look, I am a dry tree."
native_verses.56:4: For this is what the LORD says: "To the eunuchs who keep My Sabbaths, and choose what I delight in, and hold fast to My covenant,
native_verses.56:5: to them I will give in My house and within My walls a monument and a name better than sons and daughters; I will give each one an eternal name that will not be cut off.
native_verses.56:6: And the foreigners who join themselves to the LORD to minister to Him, and to love the name of the LORD, to be servants to Him, everyone who keeps the Sabbath without profaning it, and those who hold fast to My covenant,
native_verses.56:7: I will bring them to My holy mountain and gladden them in My house of prayer; their burnt offerings and their sacrifices will find acceptance on My altar, because My house will be called a house of prayer for all the peoples."
native_verses.56:8: The Lord GOD, who gathers the banished of Israel, declares: "I will gather still others to him, in addition to his gathered ones."
native_verses.56:9: All you wild animals of the field, come to eat, all you wild animals in the forest!
native_verses.56:10: His watchmen are blind; they all know nothing. They are all mute dogs that cannot bark, dreaming, lying down, loving to doze.
native_verses.56:11: And the dogs are fierce in appetite; they do not know satisfaction. And they are shepherds who do not know how to understand; all of them have turned to their own way, each man for his dishonest gain, without exception.
native_verses.56:12: "Come," they say, "I will get wine, and we will drink deeply of strong drink. And tomorrow will be like this day—vastly greater."
native_verses.57:1: The righteous one perishes, and no one takes it to heart; and men of loyal love are taken away, with no one understanding that the righteous one is taken away from calamity.
native_verses.57:2: He comes into peace; they rest on their beds, whoever walks in his uprightness.
native_verses.57:3: But you, come close here, sons of a sorceress, seed of an adulterer and of her who commits prostitution!
native_verses.57:4: At whom are you mocking? At whom do you open wide the mouth and stretch out the tongue? Are you not children of rebellion, seed of falsehood,
native_verses.57:5: you who are inflamed with passion among the oaks, beneath every lush tree, who slaughter the children in the ravines, beneath the clefts of the rocks?
native_verses.57:6: Your portion is among the smooth stones of the ravine; they, yes they, are your lot. Even to them you have poured out a drink offering; you have offered up a grain offering. Should I be appeased over these things?
native_verses.57:7: On a high and elevated mountain you placed your bed; even there you went up to offer a sacrifice.
native_verses.57:8: Behind the door and the doorpost you placed your memorial; for away from Me you uncovered yourself and climbed up, you widened your bed and struck a bargain for yourself with them; you loved their bed, you gazed at nakedness.
native_verses.57:9: You traveled to the king with oil and multiplied your perfumes; you sent out your envoys far away, and brought yourself low down to Sheol.
native_verses.57:10: From the length of your way you grew weary, yet you did not say, "It is hopeless." You found revival of your strength; therefore you did not weaken.
native_verses.57:11: And whom did you dread and fear, that you dealt falsely, and did not remember Me, nor take it to your heart? Have I not been keeping silent, even from long ago, so that you do not fear Me?
native_verses.57:12: I Myself will announce your righteousness and your works, and they will not benefit you.
native_verses.57:13: When you cry out, let your gathered throngs rescue you! But a wind will carry them all off; a breath will snatch them away. Yet the one who takes refuge in Me will inherit the land and will possess My holy mountain.
native_verses.57:14: And it will be said, "Build up, build up, clear a way! Remove the stumbling block from the way of My people!"
native_verses.57:15: For this is what the One who is high and exalted, who dwells in eternity, and whose name is Holy says: "I dwell in a high and holy place, and with the one who is crushed and lowly in spirit, to revive the spirit of the lowly, and to revive the heart of the crushed.
native_verses.57:16: For I will not strive forever, and I will not be wrathful perpetually; for the spirit would fail before Me, and the breaths of life that I Myself have made.
native_verses.57:17: Because of the iniquity of his dishonest gain I was wrathful and struck him; I hid Myself and was wrathful, yet he kept going waywardly in the way of his heart.
native_verses.57:18: I have seen his ways, yet I will heal him; I will guide him and restore comforts to him and to his mourners,
native_verses.57:19: creating the fruit of the lips. Peace, peace to the one who is far and to the one who is near," says the LORD, "and I will heal him."
native_verses.57:20: But the wicked are like the churning sea, for it cannot be still, and its waters churn up mire and mud.
native_verses.57:21: "There is no peace," my God says, "for the wicked."
native_verses.58:1: Call out with full throat, do not hold back; raise your voice like a ram's horn, and announce to My people their rebellion, and to the house of Jacob their sins.
native_verses.58:2: Yet day by day they seek Me, and take pleasure in knowing My ways, like a nation that has done righteousness and has not abandoned the justice of its God; they ask Me for righteous judgments; they take pleasure in the nearness of God.
native_verses.58:3: "Why have we fasted, and You have not seen? We have afflicted our souls, and You do not take notice." Look, on the day of your fast you find pleasure, and you drive all your workers hard.
native_verses.58:4: See, you fast for dispute and strife, and to strike with a fist of wickedness. You do not fast as on this day to cause your voice to be heard on high.
native_verses.58:5: Is a fast that I choose to be like this, a day for a man to afflict his soul? Is it to bow down his head like a reed, and spread out sackcloth and ashes? Will you call this a fast, and a day of favor to the LORD?
native_verses.58:6: Is this not the fast that I choose: to untie the fetters of wickedness, to undo the straps of the yoke, and to send the crushed away free, and that you snap every yoke?
native_verses.58:7: Is it not to break your bread for the hungry, and bring the homeless poor into the house; when you see someone naked, to cover him, and not to hide yourself from your own flesh?
native_verses.58:8: Then your light will burst open like the dawn, and your healing will sprout swiftly; your righteousness will walk ahead of you; the glory of the LORD will serve as your rear guard.
native_verses.58:9: Then you will call, and the LORD will answer; you will cry for help, and He will say, "Here I am." If you remove the yoke from your midst, the pointing of the finger, and speaking wrongdoing,
native_verses.58:10: and extend your soul to the hungry, and satisfy the afflicted soul, then your light will rise in the darkness, and your gloom will be like midday.
native_verses.58:11: And the LORD will lead you continually, and satisfy your soul in scorched places, and invigorate your bones; you will become like a well-watered garden, and like a source of water whose waters never fail.
native_verses.58:12: Those from among you will rebuild the ancient ruins; you will raise up the foundations of generation upon generation; and you will be called Mender of the Breach, Restorer of Paths to Dwell In.
native_verses.58:13: If you turn your foot back from the Sabbath, from doing your own pleasures on My holy day, and call the Sabbath a delight, the holy day of the LORD honorable, and honor it by not doing your own ways, not finding your own pleasure, or speaking mere words,
native_verses.58:14: then you will take delight in the LORD, and I will make you ride upon the heights of the earth, and I will feed you with the inheritance of Jacob your father; for the mouth of the LORD has spoken.
native_verses.59:1: Look, the hand of the LORD is not too short to save, nor is His ear too heavy to hear.
native_verses.59:2: Rather, your iniquities have been making a separation between you and your God, and your sins have concealed His face from you so that He does not hear.
native_verses.59:3: For your palms are defiled with blood, and your fingers with iniquity; your lips have spoken falsehood, your tongue mutters injustice.
native_verses.59:4: No one brings suit in righteousness, and no one pleads a case in faithfulness; they trust in emptiness and speak lies; they conceive trouble and give birth to wrongdoing.
native_verses.59:5: They hatch adder's eggs and weave spider's webs; the one who eats from their eggs dies, and what is crushed splits open into a viper.
native_verses.59:6: Their webs will not become clothing, nor will they cover themselves with their works; their works are works of wrongdoing, and an act of violence is in their palms.
native_verses.59:7: Their feet run to evil, and they hurry to shed innocent blood; their thoughts are thoughts of wrongdoing; devastation and shattering are on their highways.
native_verses.59:8: They have not known the way of peace, and there is no justice in their tracks; they have twisted their paths for themselves; whoever treads on them knows no peace.
native_verses.59:9: Therefore justice is far from us, and righteousness does not reach us; we wait for light, and look, darkness; for brightness, yet we walk about in deep gloom.
native_verses.59:10: We grope for a wall like the blind, and like those without eyes we grope; we stumble at midday as in twilight; among the vigorous we are like the dead.
native_verses.59:11: All of us growl like bears, and like doves we moan continually; we wait for justice, and there is none; for salvation, yet it is far from us.
native_verses.59:12: For our rebellions have multiplied before You, and our sins testify against us; for our rebellions are with us, and as for our iniquities, we know them:
native_verses.59:13: rebelling against and denying the LORD, and turning back from following our God, speaking oppression and revolt, conceiving and muttering from the heart words of falsehood.
native_verses.59:14: And justice is turned backward, and righteousness stands far off; for truth has stumbled in the public square, and uprightness cannot enter.
native_verses.59:15: Thus truth is missing, and the one who turns aside from evil becomes prey. And the LORD saw it, and it was displeasing in His eyes that there was no justice.
native_verses.59:16: He saw that there was no man, and He was appalled that there was no one to intervene; then His own arm brought salvation for Him, and His righteousness itself upheld Him.
native_verses.59:17: He put on righteousness like a coat of mail, with a helmet of salvation on His head; He put on garments of vengeance as attire, and wrapped Himself in zeal like a cloak.
native_verses.59:18: According to deeds, accordingly He will repay: wrath to His adversaries, recompense to His enemies; to the coastlands He will repay recompense.
native_verses.59:19: And they will fear the name of the LORD from the west, and His glory from the rising of the sun; for He will come like a pent-up river that the breath of the LORD drives forward.
native_verses.59:20: And a Redeemer will come to Zion, and to those in Jacob who turn from rebellion, declares the LORD.
native_verses.59:21: "And as for Me, this is My covenant with them," says the LORD: "My Spirit who is upon you, and My words that I have placed in your mouth, will not depart from your mouth, nor from the mouth of your seed, nor from the mouth of your seed's seed," says the LORD, "from this moment and forever."
native_verses.60:1: Rise up, shine, for your light has come, and the glory of the LORD has dawned upon you.
native_verses.60:2: For look, darkness will cover the earth, and thick gloom the peoples; yet upon you the LORD will dawn, and His glory will appear over you.
native_verses.60:3: And nations will walk to your light, and kings to the brightness of your dawn.
native_verses.60:4: Lift your eyes all around and see: they have all gathered together, they come to you; your sons will come from afar, and your daughters will be carried at the hip.
native_verses.60:5: Then you will see and be radiant, and your heart will throb and expand; because the abundance of the sea will be turned toward you, the wealth of the nations will come to you.
native_verses.60:6: A throng of camels will cover you, the young camels of Midian and Ephah; all of them will come from Sheba; they will carry gold and frankincense, and herald the praises of the LORD.
native_verses.60:7: All the flocks of Kedar will be gathered to you; the rams of Nebaioth will minister to you; they will go up with acceptance onto My altar, and I will beautify the house of My splendor.
native_verses.60:8: Who are these that fly like a cloud, and like doves to their windows?
native_verses.60:9: Surely the coastlands wait for Me, and the ships of Tarshish first, to bring your sons from afar, their silver and their gold with them, for the name of the LORD your God, and for the Holy One of Israel, because He has glorified you.
native_verses.60:10: And foreigners will build your walls, and their kings will minister to you; for in My wrath I struck you, yet in My favor I have had compassion on you.
native_verses.60:11: Your gates will stand open continually; day and night they will not be shut, to bring to you the wealth of the nations, with their kings led along.
native_verses.60:12: For the nation and the kingdom that do not serve you will perish, and those nations will be utterly laid waste.
native_verses.60:13: The glory of Lebanon will come to you, the cypress, the plane tree, and the boxwood together, to beautify the place of My sanctuary; and I will make glorious the place of My feet.
native_verses.60:14: The sons of those who afflicted you will walk to you bowing low, and all who despised you will bow down at the soles of your feet; and they will call you the City of the LORD, Zion of the Holy One of Israel.
native_verses.60:15: Instead of your being forsaken and hated, with no one passing through, I will make you an everlasting majesty, a joy from generation to generation.
native_verses.60:16: You will nurse on the milk of nations, and you will nurse at the breast of kings; and you will know that I, the LORD, am your Savior and your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.
native_verses.60:17: Instead of bronze I will bring gold, and instead of iron I will bring silver, and instead of wood, bronze, and instead of stones, iron. And I will make your oversight peace, and your taskmasters righteousness.
native_verses.60:18: Violence will no longer be heard in your land, nor devastation and shattering within your borders; but you will call your walls Salvation, and your gates Praise.
native_verses.60:19: The sun will no longer serve as your light by day, nor for brightness will the moon give light to you; rather, the LORD will be an everlasting light for you, and your God your splendor.
native_verses.60:20: Your sun will no longer go down, nor will your moon be withdrawn; for the LORD will be an everlasting light for you, and the days of your mourning will be completed.
native_verses.60:21: Your people will all be righteous; they will possess the land forever, the shoot of My plantings, the work of My hands, that I may display My splendor.
native_verses.60:22: The small one will become a thousand, and the least one a mighty nation. I, the LORD, will hasten it at its time.
native_verses.61:1: The Spirit of the Lord GOD is on me, because the LORD has anointed me to announce good news to the humble; He has sent me to bandage those broken in heart, to proclaim release to the captives and freedom to those who are bound,
native_verses.61:2: to proclaim a year of the LORD's favor and a day of our God's vengeance, to console all mourners,
native_verses.61:3: to provide for the mourners of Zion, to give them a headdress in place of ashes, oil of joy in place of mourning, a cloak of praise in place of a failing spirit. And they will be called terebinths of righteousness, a planting of the LORD, so that He may glorify Himself.
native_verses.61:4: They will build up the ruins of old; they will raise up the desolations of former times, and they will renew the cities of ruin, the desolations of generation after generation.
native_verses.61:5: Strangers will stand and shepherd your flock, and foreigners will be your plowmen and your vineyard workers.
native_verses.61:6: But you will be called "Priests of the LORD," and it will be said of you, "Ministers of our God." You will consume the wealth of nations, and you will boast in their glory.
native_verses.61:7: In place of your shame there will be a double share, and in place of disgrace they will shout for joy over their portion; therefore in their land they will inherit a double share, and everlasting gladness will belong to them.
native_verses.61:8: For I, the LORD, love justice; I hate robbery in a burnt offering. And I will give their recompense in faithfulness, and I will make an everlasting covenant with them.
native_verses.61:9: Their seed will become known among the nations, and their posterity in the midst of the peoples; everyone who sees them will recognize them, that they are a seed whom the LORD has blessed.
native_verses.61:10: I rejoice exceedingly in the LORD; my soul exults in my God, for He has dressed me in garments of salvation, and He has wrapped me in a robe of righteousness, like a bridegroom who puts on a headdress like a priest, and like a bride who arrays herself with her ornaments.
native_verses.61:11: For just as the earth brings out its sprouts, and as a garden makes its sown seeds sprout, so the Lord GOD will make righteousness and praise sprout in the sight of all the nations.
native_verses.62:1: For the sake of Zion I will not remain silent, and for the sake of Jerusalem I will not be still, until her righteousness goes out like radiance, and her salvation like a torch that blazes.
native_verses.62:2: And nations will see your righteousness, and all kings your glory; and you will be called a new name, which the mouth of the LORD will specify.
native_verses.62:3: And you will be a crown of splendor in the hand of the LORD, and a royal turban in the palm of your God.
native_verses.62:4: No longer will it be said of you, "Forsaken," and of your land it will no longer be said, "Desolate"; instead, you will be called "My Delight Is in Her," and your land "Married," for the LORD delights in you, and your land will be married.
native_verses.62:5: For as a young man marries a virgin, your sons will marry you; and with the joy of a bridegroom over a bride, your God will rejoice over you.
native_verses.62:6: On your walls, Jerusalem, I have stationed watchmen; all day and all night, continually, they will not remain silent. You who remind the LORD, let there be no rest for you,
native_verses.62:7: and do not give Him rest until He firmly establishes and until He makes Jerusalem a praise in the earth.
native_verses.62:8: The LORD has sworn by His right hand and by the arm of His strength: "Surely I will no longer give your grain as food to your enemies, nor will foreigners drink your new wine for which you have toiled;
native_verses.62:9: rather, those who harvest it will eat it and praise the LORD, and those who gather it will drink it in My holy courts."
native_verses.62:10: Pass through, pass through the gates; clear the way of the people; build up, build up the highway, rid it of stones; raise a banner over the peoples.
native_verses.62:11: Look, the LORD has announced to the end of the earth: "Say to the daughter of Zion, 'See, your salvation is coming! Look, His reward is with Him, and His recompense is before Him.'"
native_verses.62:12: And they will call them "The Holy People, the Redeemed of the LORD," and you will be called "Sought After, a City Not Forsaken."
native_verses.63:1: Who is this coming from Edom, with crimson garments from Bozrah, this One stately in His attire, striding in the abundance of His strength? "It is I, speaking in righteousness, powerful to save."
native_verses.63:2: Why is there red on Your attire, and Your garments like those of one treading in a winepress?
native_verses.63:3: "I have trodden the wine trough by Myself, and from the peoples no man was with Me; I trod them in My anger and trampled them in My fury, and their lifeblood spattered onto My garments, and I stained all My attire.
native_verses.63:4: For a day of vengeance was in My heart, and the year of My redemption had come.
native_verses.63:5: I looked, and there was no helper; I was astounded, and there was no one to sustain; so My own arm won salvation for Me, and My fury itself sustained Me.
native_verses.63:6: And I trampled peoples in My anger, made them drunk in My fury, and brought their lifeblood down to the ground."
native_verses.63:7: I will bring to remembrance the LORD's acts of loyal love, the praises of the LORD, in keeping with everything the LORD has bestowed on us, and the abundant goodness toward the house of Israel that He bestowed on them in accordance with His compassions and in accordance with the multitude of His acts of loyal love.
native_verses.63:8: And He said, "Truly they are My people, children who will not prove false." So He became a Savior to them.
native_verses.63:9: In all their distress He was distressed, and the angel of His presence saved them; in His love and in His mercy He Himself redeemed them, and He raised them up and bore them all the days of old.
native_verses.63:10: Yet they rebelled and grieved His Holy Spirit; so He turned into an enemy toward them, and He Himself fought against them.
native_verses.63:11: Then His people recalled the days of old, of Moses: "Where is the One who brought them up from the sea along with the shepherds of His flock? Where is the One who placed His Holy Spirit within them,
native_verses.63:12: who made the arm of His splendor move at the right hand of Moses, who split the waters before them to make an everlasting name for Himself,
native_verses.63:13: who guided them through the depths?" As a horse in the wilderness, they did not stumble.
native_verses.63:14: Like livestock descending into the valley, the Spirit of the LORD granted them rest; so You led Your people, to make a name of splendor for Yourself.
native_verses.63:15: Look down from heaven and see, from the habitation of Your holiness and Your splendor. Where are Your zeal and Your mighty acts? The yearning of Your inner being and Your compassions are held back toward me.
native_verses.63:16: For You are our Father, even though Abraham does not know us and Israel does not recognize us; You, LORD, are our Father; "Our Redeemer from Everlasting" is Your name.
native_verses.63:17: Why, LORD, do You cause us to wander from Your ways and harden our heart away from fearing You? Turn back for the sake of Your servants, the tribes of Your inheritance.
native_verses.63:18: For a short while Your holy people held possession; our adversaries have trampled Your sanctuary.
native_verses.63:19: We have become like those over whom You have not ruled from long ago, over whom Your name has not been called. If only You would tear open the heavens and come down, so that mountains would quake before Your presence!
native_verses.64:1: As fire ignites brushwood and fire sets water boiling, to make Your name known to Your foes, nations tremble at Your presence.
native_verses.64:2: When You performed awesome deeds we did not anticipate, You came down; mountains quaked at Your presence.
native_verses.64:3: And from ancient times they have not heard nor given ear, nor has an eye seen a God apart from You who acts for the one who waits for Him.
native_verses.64:4: You meet the one who rejoices and practices righteousness, those who remember You in Your ways. Look, You were angry, and we sinned; in them we have been a long time, and shall we be saved?
native_verses.64:5: And we have all become like someone unclean, and all our righteous deeds are like a menstrual cloth; we all wither like a leaf, and our iniquities, like the wind, carry us away.
native_verses.64:6: And there is no one who calls on Your name, who stirs himself to lay hold of You, because You have hidden Your face from us and melted us in the hand of our iniquity.
native_verses.64:7: Yet now, LORD, You are our Father; we are the clay and You are our potter; all of us are the work of Your hand.
native_verses.64:8: Do not be exceedingly angry, LORD, and do not remember iniquity forever. Now, please look: all of us are Your people.
native_verses.64:9: Your holy cities have turned into a wilderness; Zion has turned into a wilderness, Jerusalem a wasteland.
native_verses.64:10: Our holy and splendid house, where our fathers praised You, has been burned up with fire, and all our treasured things have become a ruin.
native_verses.64:11: Will You hold Yourself back over these things, LORD? Will You remain silent and afflict us exceedingly?
native_verses.65:1: I let Myself be consulted by those who did not ask; I let Myself be found by those who did not seek Me. I said, "Here I am, here I am," to a nation that was not called by My name.
native_verses.65:2: I have spread out My hands all day long to a stubborn people, who walk on a way that is not good, after their own thoughts.
native_verses.65:3: The people who continually provoke Me before My face, sacrificing in the gardens and burning incense on the bricks,
native_verses.65:4: who sit in the tombs and stay the night in hidden places, who eat the flesh of swine, while broth of foul meat is in their vessels,
native_verses.65:5: who say, "Stay by yourself; do not approach me, for I am holier than you"—these are smoke in My nostrils, a fire burning all day long.
native_verses.65:6: Look, it is written before Me: I will not remain silent, but I will repay—and I will repay onto their lap—
native_verses.65:7: your iniquities and the iniquities of your fathers together, says the LORD, who burned incense on the mountains and reviled Me on the hills; so I will first measure out their wage into their lap.
native_verses.65:8: This is what the LORD says: "Just as new wine is found in the cluster and someone says, 'Do not destroy it, because a blessing is in it,' so will I act for the sake of My servants, so as not to destroy all of it.
native_verses.65:9: I will bring out seed from Jacob, and from Judah an inheritor of My mountains; My chosen ones will inherit it, and My servants will reside there.
native_verses.65:10: Sharon will become a grazing land for flocks, and the Valley of Achor a resting place for cattle, for My people who have sought Me.
native_verses.65:11: But as for you who abandon the LORD, who forget My holy mountain, who prepare a table for Fortune and fill up mixed wine for Destiny,
native_verses.65:12: I will destine you for the sword, and all of you will kneel down to the slaughter, because I called and you did not answer, I spoke and you did not listen; instead, you did evil in My eyes and chose that in which I took no pleasure."
native_verses.65:13: Therefore, this is what the Lord GOD says: "Look, My servants will eat, but you will go hungry; look, My servants will drink, but you will go thirsty; look, My servants will rejoice, but you will be shamed.
native_verses.65:14: Look, My servants will shout for joy from gladness of heart, but you will cry out from anguish of heart, and from a broken spirit you will wail.
native_verses.65:15: You will leave your name behind as an oath-curse for My chosen ones, and the Lord GOD will put you to death, while He will call His servants by a different name,
native_verses.65:16: so that whoever blesses himself in the land will bless himself by the God of truth, and whoever swears in the land will swear by the God of truth, because the former distresses have been forgotten, and because they have been hidden from My eyes.
native_verses.65:17: For look, I am creating new heavens and a new earth; the former things will not be remembered, nor will they arise in the heart.
native_verses.65:18: Instead, be joyful and exult forever and ever in what I am creating; for look, I am creating Jerusalem as exultation and her people as joy.
